### 📄 `.gitlab-ci.yml` [2.475 octets]
<a id="-gitlab-ci-yml"></a> [↩ Retour à l'arborescence](#tree--gitlab-ci-yml)

> **Lignes** : 87  
> **Type** : yaml

```yaml
stages:
  - build_and_publish_war
  - sonarqube-check
  - pages
 
build_and_publish_war:
  image: maven:3.6-adoptopenjdk-8 
  stage: build_and_publish_war
  cache:
    paths:
      - .m2/repository
  artifacts:
    name: "$CI_BUILD"
    paths:
      - "**/*"
    when: always
    expire_in: 3 days
  script:
    - >
      mvn install:install-file 
      -Dfile=$CI_PROJECT_DIR/maven-dependencies/cerbere-client-4.7.4.jar 
      -DgroupId=fr.gouv.e2.cerbere 
      -DartifactId=cerbere-client 
      -Dversion=4.7.4 
      -Dpackaging=jar
    - >
      mvn install:install-file 
      -Dfile=$CI_PROJECT_DIR/maven-dependencies/importfichiersirene-0.1.jar
      -DgroupId=fr.gouv.e2.sireines
      -DartifactId=importfichiersirene
      -Dversion=0.1 
      -Dpackaging=jar
    - >
      mvn install:install-file 
      -Dfile=$CI_PROJECT_DIR/maven-dependencies/systemRoutines-1.0.jar 
      -DgroupId=fr.gouv.e2.sireines
      -DartifactId=systemRoutines 
      -Dversion=1.0 
      -Dpackaging=jar
    - mvn clean compile -s settings.xml
  when: manual

sonarqube-check:
  stage: sonarqube-check
  image: 
    name: sonarsource/sonar-scanner-cli:latest
    entrypoint: [""]
  variables:
    SONAR_USER_HOME: "${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/.sonar"  # Defines the location of the analysis task cache
    GIT_DEPTH: "0"  # Tells git to fetch all the branches of the project, required by the analysis task
  cache:
    key: "${CI_JOB_NAME}"
    paths:
      - .sonar/cache
      
  script: 
    - ls -d ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/sireines-web/*
    - sonar-scanner -Dsonar.java.binaries=sireines-web/target/classes
  allow_failure: true
  when: manual
  needs:
    - job: build_and_publish_war
      artifacts: true 



# https://snum.pnm3.produits.rh.sireines.gitlab.io/
# https://<your-username-or-group>.gitlab.io/<your-project-name>/ 
pages:
  image: alpine:latest
  stage: pages
  script:
    - apk add --no-cache tree # Installez tree ici
    - mkdir -p public/stats # Créez le répertoire stats si nécessaire
    - mkdir -p public/budget # Créez le répertoire budget si nécessaire
    - cp index.html public
    - cp mentions-legales.md public/mentions-legales
    - cp declaration-rgpd.md public/declaration-rgpd
    - cp declaration-accessibilite.html public/declaration-accessibilite
    - cp stats.md public/stats
    - cp budget.md public/budget
    - tree public # Affichez la structure des dossiers et fichiers dans 'public'
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - public
  when: manual
  
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>


<h1>Déclaration d’accessibilité</h1>
<p>
	Établie le
	<span>30 mai 2024</span>.
</p>
<p>
	<span>Notre organisation</span>
	s’engage à rendre son service accessible, conformément à
	l’article 47 de la loi n° 2005-102 du 11 février 2005.
</p>
<p>
	Cette déclaration d’accessibilité s’applique à
	<strong>ce service</strong>.
</p>
<h2>État de conformité</h2>
<p>
	<strong>Notre site</strong>
	est
	<strong><span data-printfilter="lowercase">non conforme</span></strong>
	avec le
	<abbr title="Référentiel général d’amélioration de l’accessibilité">RGAA</abbr>. <span>Le site n’a encore pas été audité.<br></span>
</p>
<h2>Voie de recours</h2>
<p>
	Cette procédure est à utiliser dans le cas suivant&nbsp;: vous avez
	signalé au responsable du site internet un défaut
	d’accessibilité qui vous empêche d’accéder à un contenu ou à un
	des services du portail et vous n’avez pas obtenu de réponse
	satisfaisante.
</p>
<p>Vous pouvez&nbsp;:</p>
<ul>
	<li>
	Écrire un message au
	<a href="https://formulaire.defenseurdesdroits.fr/">Défenseur des droits</a>
</li>
	<li>
	Contacter
	<a href="https://www.defenseurdesdroits.fr/saisir/delegues">le délégué du Défenseur des droits dans votre région</a>
</li>
	<li>
	Envoyer un courrier par la poste (gratuit, ne pas mettre de
	timbre)&nbsp;:<br>
	Défenseur des droits<br>
	Libre réponse 71120 75342 Paris CEDEX 07
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p>
	Cette déclaration d’accessibilité a été créé le
	<span>30 mai 2024</span>
	grâce au
	<a href="https://betagouv.github.io/a11y-generateur-declaration/#create">Générateur de Déclaration d’Accessibilité de BetaGouv</a>.
</p>
```

```markdown
Mentions légales de SIREINES

Editeur de la Plateforme
La Plateforme SIREINES est éditée par [Nom de l’éditeur] situé :
[Adresse éditeur]
[Téléphone éditeur]
[Mail éditeur]

Directeur de la publication
[Nom du Directeur de la publication]

Hébergement de la Plateforme
Ce site est hébergé en propre par [Hébergeur] : [Adresse de l’hébergeur]

Accessibilité
La conformité aux normes d’accessibilité numérique est un objectif ultérieur mais nous tâchons de rendre ce site accessible à toutes et à tous.

Signaler un dysfonctionnement
Si vous rencontrez un défaut d’accessibilité vous empêchant d’accéder à un contenu ou une fonctionnalité du site, merci de nous en faire part.
Si vous n’obtenez pas de réponse rapide de notre part, vous êtes en droit de faire parvenir vos doléances ou une demande de saisine au Défenseur des droits.

En savoir plus
Pour en savoir plus sur la politique d’accessibilité numérique de l’État : http://references.modernisation.gouv.fr/accessibilite-numerique

Sécurité
Le site est protégé par un certificat électronique, matérialisé pour la grande majorité des navigateurs par un cadenas. Cette protection participe à la confidentialité des échanges.
En aucun cas les services associés à la plateforme ne seront à l’origine d’envoi de courriels pour demander la saisie d’informations personnelles.
```

````markdown
# SIREINES :

# Mise à jour du numéro de version :

Le numéro de version est à mettre à jour à un seul endroit : la propriété **revision** du pom parent, toutes les mentions de la version ailleurs sont déduites de là.

# Mise en oeuvre d'un dump de base de données (prérequis aux tests locaux) :

La base de données de l'application tourne sous Postgresql, ce qui permet facilement l'utilisation de l'image docker officielle quel que soit le contexte (dév, intégration, recette, preprod, prod).

Par exemple en local, en supposant que vous disposez d'un dump **dump.dmp** au format binaire :

1. Lancez un container sur la base l'image **postgres:15.2-alpine** avec son répertoire persisté au "bon endroit" pour être récupéré par la stack containérisée par la suite :

    ```
    docker run --rm -e POSTGRES_USER=******* -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=******* -e POSTGRES_DB=sireines -p 5432:5432 -d -v [VOTRE_RACINE]/sireines/sireines-docker/pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:15.2-alpine
    ```

    où les étoiles sont à remplacer par vos valeurs locales de user/mot de passe Postgres.

2. Une fois le container démarré (vérifiez avec les logs), il faut copier le dump à la racine :

    ```
    docker cp [VOTRE_RACINE]/dump.dmp sireines-db:/dump.dmp
    ```

3. Rendez-vous dans le container :

    ```
    docker exec -it sireines-db /bin/bash/
    [root@4314a1d3c2eb /]#
    ```

4. Lancez la commande d'import avec **pg_restore** :

    ```
    [root@4314a1d3c2eb /]# pg_restore -U ******* -d sireines < dump.dmp
    ```

    où **\*\*\*\*\*\*\*** est votre user Postgres.

5. Vous pouvez enfin sortir et supprimer le container, les données ont été restaurées.

## Mise en oeuvre locale :

Avant de tenter de compiler localement le projet avec Maven, il convient d'ajouter les dépendances "locale" au dépôt _.m2/repository_ de votre poste via les commandes suivantes :

```
mvn install:install-file \
    -Dfile=maven-dependencies/cerbere-client-4.7.4.jar \
    -DgroupId=fr.gouv.e2.cerbere \
    -DartifactId=cerbere-client \
    -Dversion=4.7.4 \
    -Dpackaging=jar

mvn install:install-file \
    -Dfile=maven-dependencies/importfichiersirenes-0.1.jar \
    -DgroupId=fr.gouv.e2.sireines \
    -DartifactId=importfichiersirenes \
    -Dversion=0.1 \
    -Dpackaging=jar

mvn install:install-file \
    -Dfile=maven-dependencies/systemRoutines-1.0.jar \
    -DgroupId=fr.gouv.e2.sireines \
    -DartifactId=systemRoutines \
    -Dversion=1.0 \
    -Dpackaging=jar
```

Une compilation peut ensuite être lancée à partir de ce dossier via la commande :

```
mvn clean install compile package
```

Le **.war** résultant se trouvera dans le dossier _sireines-web/target/_.

Afin de builder l'image docker de dév il faudra ensuite copier ce war dans le répertoire docker :

```
cp sireines-web/target/sireines-web.war sireines-web/
```

Puis builder l'image à proprement parler :

```
docker compose -f sireines-docker/docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache app
```

Une fois l'image buildée il convient de créer un fichier **.env** dans le répertoire _sireines-docker/_ sur le modèle du fichier **.env.sample** fourni et valorisé correctement.
Ceci fait la stack containérisée peut être lancée via la commande :

```
source sireines-docker/.env && docker compose -f sireines-docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
```

Et une fois l'application démarrée, celle-ci est disponible en local sur http://127.0.0.1.

## Mise en oeuvre de l'artefact issu de la CI :

Dans le cas d'une volonté de mise en oeuvre de l'artefact buildé par la CI de Gitlab, il suffit de prendre le fichier compose **docker-compose.yml** dans le répertoire _sireines-docker/_, de créer de même un fichier **.env** et, avec les accès à la registry GCP du département dont vous disposez déjà normalement, votre instance de docker devrait pouvoir tirer les images et lancer la stack via un :

```
source sireines-docker/.env && docker compose -f sireines-docker/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

## Point(s) d'attention :

SIREINES utilise le générateur de rapport [BIRT](https://projects.eclipse.org/projects/technology.birt) pour sa partie "extractions", ce dernier compte sur la présence des fichiers de rapports **.rptdesign** dans le dossier _/usr/local/tomcat/webapps/ROOT/report_/

Ce chemin est paramétré en dur dans le fichier **src/main/java/i2/application/sireines/service/extractions/ExtractionsServicesImpl.java** au sein de la variable privée **MODEL_HOME**.

Si, pour une raison ou pour une autre, ce chemin doit être mis à jour c'est dans ce fichier qu'il faut faire la modification ainsi que dans le fichier **META-INF/context.xml** qui reprend le chemin vers le répertoire d'extractions.

Par ailleurs (et malheureusement) chaque rapport BIRT contient ses propres paramètres de connexion à la base de données, il faut donc les paramétrer correctement au démarrage de l'application, ce qui se fait via le script d'entrypoint fourni dans le dossier _sireines-docker/_. Merci d'être attentif à ce point lors de toute évolution concernant les rapports BIRT.
````

```text
<o:TextTargetItem Id="o58">
<a:ObjectID>15CEB2CA-AB25-4E60-A57C-2AB19D0EE96C</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>SqlListQuery</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>{OWNER, TABLE, TABLE_TYPE}

select
   u.usename,
   t.relname,
   case substring(t.relname from 1 for 3)
      when &#39;pg_&#39; then &#39;SYSTEM TABLE&#39; else &#39;TABLE&#39;
   end::varchar
from
   pg_catalog.pg_class t,
   pg_catalog.pg_shadow u
where t.relkind = &#39;r&#39;
   and t.relowner = u.usesysid
[  and u.usename = %.q:SCHEMA%]
order by 1, 2</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>SQL query to list objects</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>

   &quot;INDEX&quot;        // generated code of the index
   &quot;INDEXNAME&quot;    // index name
   &quot;INDEXCODE&quot;    // index code
   &quot;UNIQUE&quot;       // keyword &quot;unique&quot; when the index is unique
   &quot;INDEXTYPE&quot;    // index type (available only for a few DBMS)
   &quot;INDEXKEY&quot;     // keywords &quot;primary&quot;, &quot;unique&quot; or &quot;foreign&quot; depending on the index origin
   &quot;CIDXLIST&quot;     // list of index columns. Eg: A asc, B desc, C asc
   &quot;CLUSTER&quot;      // keyword &quot;cluster&quot; when the index is cluster
For index columns, the following system variables are available:
   &quot;ASC&quot;          // keywords &quot;ASC&quot; or &quot;DESC&quot; depending on sort order
   &quot;ISASC&quot;        // TRUE if the index column sort is ascending
</a:Comment>
<c:Categories>

<o:TextTargetItem Id="o71">
<a:ObjectID>F8BF539A-3A75-4E49-B219-010FDAF8216E</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>SqlListQuery</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>{OWNER ID, TABLE ID, INDEX ID, UNIQUE ID, CIDXLIST ...}

select
   u.usename,
   t.relname,
   i.relname,
   case (x.indisunique)
      when true then &#39;unique&#39; else &#39;&#39;
   end::varchar,
   a.attname || &#39;,&#39;::varchar
from
   pg_user u,
   pg_class t,
   pg_class i,
   pg_index x,
   pg_attribute a
where 1=1
   and t.relowner=u.usesysid
   and x.indrelid=t.oid
   and x.indexrelid=i.oid
   and a.attrelid=i.oid
   and x.indisprimary is false
[  and u.usename=%.q:OWNER%]
[  and t.relname=%.q:TABLE%]
order by 
   u.usename,
   t.relname,
   i.relname,
   a.attnum
</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>SQL query to list objects</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>
</c:Categories>

<o:TextTargetItem Id="o93">
<a:ObjectID>1F2E557D-6DC3-4B64-8E4D-829F7ECC7F56</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>SqlListQuery</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>{OWNER, TABLE, COLUMN, DTTPCODE, LENGTH, PREC, ISMAND, DEFAULT}

select 
   u.usename,
   t.relname,
   c.attname,
   d.typname,
   case(c.atttypmod &gt;&gt; 16) when 0 then (c.atttypmod - ((c.atttypmod &gt;&gt; 16)&lt;&lt;16) - 4) else (c.atttypmod &gt;&gt; 16) end,
   case(c.atttypmod &gt;&gt; 16) when 0 then 0 else (c.atttypmod - 65536 * (c.atttypmod / 65536) - 4) end,
   c.attnotnull,
   case(c.atthasdef) 
      when true then (select adsrc::varchar from pg_attrdef f where f.adrelid = t.oid and f.adnum = c.attnum)::varchar
      else &#39;&#39; end::varchar
from
   pg_catalog.pg_type d,
   pg_catalog.pg_attribute c,
   pg_catalog.pg_class t,
   pg_catalog.pg_shadow u
where t.relkind = &#39;r&#39;
   and t.relowner = u.usesysid
   and c.attrelid = t.oid
   and c.attnum &gt; 0
   and c.attisdropped is false
   and d.oid = c.atttypid
[  and u.usename = %.q:OWNER%]
[  and t.relname = %.q:TABLE%]
order by 1, 2, c.attnum</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>SQL query to list objects</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>

<a:ObjectID>CC010FC2-24A5-4138-9C91-9DB99C86E771</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>Reference</a:Name>
<a:Code>REFR</a:Code>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>The following system variables are available:
   &quot;REFR&quot;         // generated code of the reference
   &quot;REFNAME&quot;      // reference name
   &quot;PARENT&quot;       // generated code of the parent table
   &quot;PNAME&quot;        // name of the parent table
   &quot;PCODE&quot;        // code of the parent table
   &quot;CHILD&quot;        // generated code of the reference
   &quot;CNAME&quot;        // name of the child table
   &quot;CCODE&quot;        // code of the child table
   &quot;PQUALIFIER&quot;   // qualifier of the parent table. See QUALIFIER
   &quot;CQUALIFIER&quot;   // qualifier of the child table. See QUALIFIER
   &quot;REFRNAME&quot;     // Reference name
   &quot;REFRCODE&quot;     // Reference code
   &quot;FKCONSTRAINT&quot; // Reference constraint name (foreign key)
   &quot;PKCONSTRAINT&quot; // constraint name of the parent key used to reference object
   &quot;CKEYCOLUMNS&quot;  // list of parent key columns. Eg: C1, C2, C3
   &quot;FKEYCOLUMNS&quot;  // list of child foreign key columns. Eg:
   &quot;UPDCONST&quot;     // Update declarative constraint. Keywords &quot;restrict&quot;, &quot;cascade&quot;, &quot;set null&quot; or &quot;set default&quot;
   &quot;DELCONST&quot;     // Delete declarative constraint. Keywords &quot;restrict&quot;, &quot;cascade&quot;, &quot;set null&quot; or &quot;set default&quot;
   &quot;MINCARD&quot;      // Min cardinality
   &quot;MAXCARD&quot;      // Max cardinality
   &quot;POWNER&quot;       // Parent table owner
   &quot;COWNER&quot;       // child table owner
   &quot;CHCKONCMMT&quot;   // TRUE when check on commit is selected on the reference (ASA 6.0 specific)

For reference joins (couple of column in a reference),
the following system variables are available:
   &quot;CKEYCOLUMN&quot;   // generated code of the parent table column (primary key)
   &quot;FKEYCOLUMN&quot;   // generated code of the child table column (foreign key)
   &quot;PK&quot;           // primary key column generated code
   &quot;PKNAME&quot;       // primary key column name
   &quot;FK&quot;           // foreign key column generated code
   &quot;FKNAME&quot;       // foreign key column name
   &quot;AK&quot;           // alternate key column code (same as PK)
   &quot;AKNAME&quot;       // alternate key column name (same as PKNAME)
   &quot;COLTYPE&quot;      // primary column column datatype
   &quot;DEFAULT&quot;      // foreign key column default value
</a:Comment>
<c:Categories>
<o:BooleanTargetItem Id="o97">

<o:TextTargetItem Id="o105">
<a:ObjectID>22651A28-A30C-4096-A816-97532C182E4E</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>SqlListQuery</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>{POWNER, PARENT, COWNER, CHILD, CONSTNAME, UPDCONST, DELCONST, FKEYCOLUMNS, CKEYCOLUMNS}

select
   u.usename,
   p.relname,
   v.usename,
   c.relname,
   k.conname,
   case(k.confupdtype)
      when &#39;r&#39; then &#39;restrict&#39;
      when &#39;c&#39; then &#39;cascade&#39;
      when &#39;n&#39; then &#39;set null&#39;
      when &#39;d&#39; then &#39;set default&#39;
      when &#39;a&#39; then &#39;no action&#39;
   end::varchar,
   case(k.confdeltype)
      when &#39;r&#39; then &#39;restrict&#39;
      when &#39;c&#39; then &#39;cascade&#39;
      when &#39;n&#39; then &#39;set null&#39;
      when &#39;d&#39; then &#39;set default&#39;
      when &#39;a&#39; then &#39;no action&#39;
   end::varchar,
   substring(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid), 1 + length(&#39;FOREIGN KEY (&#39;), strpos(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid), &#39;) REFERENCES &#39;) - length(&#39;FOREIGN KEY (&#39;) - 1)::varchar,
   substring(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid), strpos(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid), &#39;) REFERENCES &#39;||p.relname) + 1 + length(&#39;) REFERENCES &#39;||p.relname), strpos(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid), &#39;) ON &#39;) - (strpos(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid), &#39;) REFERENCES &#39;||p.relname) + 1 + length(&#39;) REFERENCES &#39;||p.relname)))::varchar
from 
   pg_catalog.pg_constraint k,
   pg_catalog.pg_class p,
   pg_catalog.pg_class c,
   pg_catalog.pg_shadow u,
   pg_catalog.pg_shadow v
where 1=1
   and k.contype = &#39;f&#39;
   and k.conrelid = c.oid
   and k.confrelid = p.oid
   and u.usesysid=p.relowner
   and v.usesysid=c.relowner
[  and v.usename=%.q:OWNER%]
[  and c.relname=%.q:TABLE%]
</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>SQL query to list objects</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>
</c:Categories>
</o:TargetCategory>

<o:TextTargetItem Id="o120">
<a:ObjectID>33C7993C-FEA7-4E63-9F82-AE8E1E0373B6</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>SqlListQuery</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>{OWNER ID, TABLE ID, CONSTNAME ID, ISPKEY ID, COLUMNS ...}

select
   u.usename,
   t.relname,
   i.relname,
   x.indisprimary,
   a.attname || &#39;,&#39;::varchar
from
   pg_user u,
   pg_class t,
   pg_class i,
   pg_index x,
   pg_attribute a
where 1=1
   and t.relowner=u.usesysid
   and x.indrelid=t.oid
   and x.indexrelid=i.oid
   and a.attrelid=i.oid
   and x.indisprimary is true
[  and u.usename=%.q:OWNER%]
[  and t.relname=%.q:TABLE%]
order by 
   u.usename,
   t.relname,
   i.relname,
   a.attnum
</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>SQL query to list objects</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>

   u.usename,
   d.typname,
   t.typname
from
   pg_catalog.pg_shadow u,
   pg_catalog.pg_type d,
   pg_catalog.pg_type t

[  and u.usename = %.q:SCHEMA%]

<a:Name>SqlListQuery</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>{OWNER, PROC, FUNC}

select
   u.usename,
   p.proname,
   case(pronargs) when 0 then &#39;&#39; else p.proname end
from
   pg_catalog.pg_proc p,
   pg_catalog.pg_language l,
   pg_catalog.pg_shadow u
where 
   l.oid = p.prolang
   and p.proowner = u.usesysid
   and l.lanname &lt;&gt; &#39;internal&#39;
[  and u.usename = %.q:SCHEMA%]</a:TextTargetItem.Value>

where

   and p.proowner = u.usesysid
   and l.lanname &lt;&gt; &#39;internal&#39;
[  and u.usename = %.q:OWNER%]
[  and p.proname = %.q:PROC%]

<a:ObjectID>E3B25061-4FDA-497E-A4DE-8263CE7A2D2E</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>Trigger</a:Name>
<a:Code>TRGR</a:Code>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>The following system variables are available:
(parent table items are also available for indexes)
 trigger object specific items
   &quot;ORDER&quot;        // order number of the trigger (to sort the triggers when the DBMS supports more than one trigger of one type)
   &quot;TRIGGER&quot;      // generated code of trigger
   &quot;TRGTYPE&quot;      // trigger type (keywords &quot;beforeinsert&quot;, &quot;afterupdate&quot;, ...)
   &quot;TRGEVENT&quot;     // trigger event (keywords &quot;insert&quot;, &quot;update&quot;, &quot;delete&quot;)
   &quot;TRGTIME&quot;      // trigger time (keywords NULL, &quot;before&quot;, &quot;after&quot;)
 inside the body of the trigger, macros redefine variables on objects
   &quot;REFNO&quot;        // reference position in the list of references of the table
 customized error messages management
   &quot;ERRNO&quot;        // error number for standard error
   &quot;ERRMSG&quot;       // error message for standard error
   &quot;MSGTAB&quot;       // name of the table containing user-defined error messages
   &quot;MSGNO&quot;        // in the user-defined error table, name of the column containing the error numbers
   &quot;MSGTXT&quot;       // in the user-defined error table, name of the column containing the error messages
   &quot;SCRIPT&quot;       // body of trigger or procedure
   &quot;TRGDEFN&quot;      // complete body of the trigger definition. Contains variable declarations and body of trigger or procedure
</a:Comment>
<c:Categories>
<o:BooleanTargetItem Id="o158">

<o:TextTargetItem Id="o160">
<a:ObjectID>B4EC308C-7741-490B-A1B9-804744013CF9</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>SqlListQuery</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>{OWNER, TABLE, TRIGGER, TRGEVENT, TRGTIME}

select
   u.usename,
   t.relname,
   g.tgname, 
   case (g.tgtype &amp; 28) 
      when 4 then &#39;insert&#39; when 8 then &#39;delete&#39; when 16 then &#39;update&#39;
      when 12 then &#39;insert or delete&#39; when 20 then &#39;insert or update&#39; when 24 then &#39;delete or update&#39; 
      when 28 then &#39;insert or delete or update&#39; else &#39;&#39; end::varchar,
   case (g.tgtype &amp; 2) 
      when 2 then &#39;before&#39; when 0 then &#39;after&#39; else &#39;&#39; end::varchar
from
   pg_catalog.pg_trigger g,
   pg_catalog.pg_class t,
   pg_catalog.pg_shadow u
where t.relkind = &#39;r&#39;
   and t.relowner = u.usesysid
   and g.tgrelid = t.oid
[  and u.usename = %.q:SCHEMA%]
order by 1, 2</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>SQL query to list objects</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>
<o:TextTargetItem Id="o161">
<a:ObjectID>54722C43-2DF6-4124-AA14-2162890305EC</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>SqlAttrQuery</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>{OWNER, TABLE, TRIGGER, TRGEVENT, TRGTIME, TRGDEFN}

select
   u.usename,
   t.relname,
   g.tgname,
   case (g.tgtype &amp; 28) 
      when 4 then &#39;insert&#39; when 8 then &#39;delete&#39; when 16 then &#39;update&#39;
      when 12 then &#39;insert or delete&#39; when 20 then &#39;insert or update&#39; when 24 then &#39;delete or update&#39; 
      when 28 then &#39;insert or delete or update&#39; else &#39;&#39; end::varchar,
   case (g.tgtype &amp; 2) 
      when 2 then &#39;before&#39; when 0 then &#39;after&#39; else &#39;&#39; end::varchar,
   (case(g.tgtype &amp; 1) when 1 then &#39; for each row&#39; else &#39; for each statement&#39; end
   ||&#39; execute procedure &#39; || p.proname)::varchar
from
   pg_catalog.pg_proc p,
   pg_catalog.pg_trigger g,
   pg_catalog.pg_class t,
   pg_catalog.pg_shadow u
where t.relkind = &#39;r&#39;
   and t.relowner = u.usesysid
   and g.tgrelid = t.oid
   and g.tgfoid = p.oid
[  and u.usename = %.q:SCHEMA%]
[  and t.relname = %.q:TABLE%]
[  and g.tgname = %.q:TRIGGER%]
order by 1, 2</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>SQL query to reverse object attributes</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>
<o:TextTargetItem Id="o162">
<a:ObjectID>DDFC4D0C-3112-43A7-9633-1E975DFE4F94</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>UseErrorMsgTable</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>let errno  = %ERRNO%;
select %MSGTXT%
into   errmsg
from   %MSGTAB%
where  %MSGNO% = %ERRNO%;
raise exception -746, 0, errmsg;</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>Errors handling using an error messages table</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>
<o:TextTargetItem Id="o163">
<a:ObjectID>344AF692-F8FD-47B1-A7F3-A759DCE6990D</a:ObjectID>
<a:Name>UseErrorMsgText</a:Name>
<a:TextTargetItem.Value>let errno  = %ERRNO%;
let errmsg = &quot;%ERRMSG%&quot;;
raise exception -746, 0, errmsg;</a:TextTargetItem.Value>
<a:CreationDate>0</a:CreationDate>
<a:Creator/>
<a:ModificationDate>0</a:ModificationDate>
<a:Modifier/>
<a:Comment>Errors handling using fixed error messages</a:Comment>
</o:TextTargetItem>
```

```text
'******************************************************************************
'* File:     synchronisation oom_pdm.vbs
'* Purpose:  génération automatique des code de clés étrangères 
'* Title:    
'* Category: 
'* Version:  1.0
'* Company:  Kleegroup
'******************************************************************************

Option Explicit
ValidationMode = True
InteractiveMode = im_Batch

' get the current active model
Dim mdl ' the current model
Set mdl = ActiveModel
Dim pdm ' pdm
Dim tgm
Dim dbms

If (mdl Is Nothing) Then
   MsgBox "There is no Active Model"
Else
   if (mdl.Iskindof(PDOom.cls_Model) )then
      if (mdl.TargetModels.count > 0 ) Then
         For Each tgm in mdl.TargetModels
            'msgBox tgm.Code
            'msgBox tgm.TargetModelFileName
            'msgBox "Code : " & tgm.Code & " TargetModelObject.ClassKind : " & tgm.TargetModelObject.ClassKind & " PdPDM.cls_Model : " & PdPDM.cls_Model & " File name : " & tgm.TargetModelFileName
            if (tgm.TargetModelObject.ClassKind = PdPDM.cls_Model) then
               set pdm = OpenModel(tgm.TargetModelFileName)
               'if (pdm.Iskindof(PDPdm.cls_Model)) then			   
                  synchro mdl,pdm
                  Exit For
               'end If
            end if
         Next
         If not (pdm.Iskindof(PDPdm.cls_Model)) then
            MsgBox "The target model is not a pdm"
         End If
      else
         MsgBox "At least a Pdm must be a target model"
      end if
   else
      MsgBox "The Active Model must be an oom"   
   end if
End If

Private Sub synchro(oom,pdm)
   'output "Synchronizing " & oom.code & " and " & pdm.code
   Dim asso
   Dim ref 
   Dim role 
   
   dim childColumn 
   dim parentColumn 
   
   dim sequen
   dim clss
   dim test 
   dim loop_sequence
   
   Dim tab
   
   if lenB(dbms) = 0 then
      dbms = pdm.DBMS.Name
    end if
   
   For Each clss in oom.Classes
      test = "false"
      if clss.isKindOf(cls_Shortcut) then
         test="true"
      end if
      for each loop_sequence in pdm.Sequences
         if (loop_sequence.Name = "seq_" & clss.Name) or (loop_sequence.Code = "SEQ_" & clss.Code)  then
            test = "true"
            Output "Séquence existe : " & loop_sequence.Name
         end if
      NEXT
      if test = "false" then
         set sequen = pdm.CreateObject(PdPDM.cls_Sequence)
         sequen.Name = "seq_" & clss.Name
         sequen.Code = "SEQ_" & clss.Code
         if dbms = "HSQL ADS" then
              sequen.PhysicalOptions = "start with 1000"
         else
            sequen.PhysicalOptions = "start with 1000 cache 20"
         end if
		 
         Output "Séquence crée : " & sequen.Name
      end if
   NEXT
                
   For Each asso In oom.Associations    
   Output "Association THIB : " & asso.Name & " CODE "& asso.Code       
     if(not(asso.IsShortcut())) then
       if (Instr(1,asso.RoleAMultiplicity,"1") > 0 or Instr(1,asso.RoleBMultiplicity,"1")) then
     
       For Each ref in pdm.References
         if (uCase(asso.code) = ref.code) then
           
             if (Instr(1,asso.code, "_") = 4 and Instr(5,asso.code, "_") = 8) then
               
                                if(ref.isKindOf(cls_Shortcut))then      
                  set ref = ref.TargetObject
                                end if                            
               
                if  (ref.joins.count = 1) then
                  set childColumn = ref.joins.item(0).ChildTableColumn 
                  set parentColumn = ref.joins.item(0).ParentTableColumn  
                  role = mid(asso.code,9,len(asso.code))
                
                  if not (childColumn is nothing) then   
                
                     if not (instr(1,childColumn.code,"_id_" & role) > 0) then
                        OutPut childColumn.parent.code & "." & childColumn.code  & " --> (code) " & parentColumn.code & "_" & ucase(role)  
                        childColumn.Code =  parentColumn.code & "_" & ucase(role)  
                     end if
                     if not (instr(1,childColumn.name,"_id_" & role) > 0) then
                        OutPut childColumn.parent.name & "." & childColumn.name  & " --> (name) " & parentColumn.name & " " & lcase(role) 
                        childColumn.name =  parentColumn.name & " " & lcase(role)  
                     end if
                 
                  end if
                end if
              end if
              exit for
          end if
        next
        end if
     end if 
   next
   For Each asso In oom.Associations
     if(not(asso.IsShortcut())) then
       if (Instr(1,asso.roleAmultiplicity,"1") > 0 or Instr(1,asso.roleBmultiplicity,"1")) then
       For Each ref in pdm.References
         if (uCase(asso.code) = ref.code) then
             ' synchronisation des associations 0..1 ou 1..1 de l'OOM trigramme1_trigramme2 sans rôle avec les références du PDM
            if (Instr(1,asso.code, "_") = 4 and (len(asso.code) = 7) ) then
                  
                  if (ref.Iskindof(cls_Reference)) then
                  if ( ref.joins.count = 1) then
                     set childColumn = ref.joins.item(0).ChildTableColumn 
                     set parentColumn = ref.joins.item(0).ParentTableColumn    
                  
                     if not (childColumn is nothing) then 
                        ' le code de la colonne migrée ne correspond pas au code de la clé de la table d'origine
                        if (childColumn.code <> parentColumn.code) then
                           ' recherche de la colonne d'origine dans la table
                           dim found, col
                           found = false
                           for each col in childColumn.parent.columns
                              if (col.code = parentColumn.code) then
                                 found = true
                                 OutPut "Impossible de renommer la colonne" & childColumn.parent.name & "." & childColumn.code & " veuillez assigner un rôle sur l'association dans le modèle objet"
                                 exit for
                              end if   
                           next
                           if (found = false) then
                              OutPut childColumn.parent.name & "." & childColumn.code  & " --> (code) " & parentColumn.code 
                              childColumn.Code =  parentColumn.code 
                              OutPut childColumn.parent.name & "." & childColumn.name  & " --> (name) " & parentColumn.code 
                              childColumn.name =  parentColumn.name 
                           end if
                        end if
                     end if 
                  end if
                  end if
            end if
            exit for
         end if
       next 
       end if
     end if
   Next
   
   
   ' go into the sub-packages
   Dim foom ' running oom folder
   Dim fpdm ' running pdm folder
   For Each foom In oom.Packages
      'calling sub procedure to scan children package
      For Each fpdm In pdm.Packages
      'calling sub procedure to scan children package
       if (uCase(foom.code) = fpdm.code) then
         synchro foom, fpdm
         exit for
       end if
      next
   Next   

End Sub

'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Sub procedure to print information on current object in output
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub DescribeObject(CurrentObject)
   if not CurrentObject.Iskindof(cls_NamedObject) then output "not an named object !" end if
  
      output "Checking "+CurrentObject.ClassName+" """+CurrentObject.Code+""", Created by "+CurrentObject.Creator+" On "+Cstr(CurrentObject.CreationDate)   
End Sub

```

```sql
drop sequence SEQ_THESAURUS;

-- La table "mot_clé" ne doit pas voir apparaître de nouveaux éléments dans le futur.
```

```sql
--Suppression des mot clé en doublon
delete from mot_cle 
where mot_cle.mcl_id in ( select mc.mcl_id from mot_cle mc 
		  join thesaurus th on th.the_id=mc.the_id 
		  join thesaurus th1 on th1.the_id=mot_cle.the_id
		  where th.libelle=th1.libelle
		  and mcl_id not in (select li.mcl 
				     from (select max(mcl_id)as mcl 
				           from mot_cle mc  
				           join thesaurus th on th.the_id=mc.the_id 
				           group by th.libelle)li));
            
--Suppression des mots clés libelle_autre en doublon
delete from mot_cle 
where mot_cle.mcl_id in ( select mc.mcl_id from mot_cle mc 
          join mot_cle mc11 on mc.libelle_autre=mc11.libelle_autre
          where mc.mcl_id not in (select max(mcx.mcl_id) from mot_cle mcx 
                    group by mcx.LIBELLE_AUTRE ));
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">

    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <artifactId>sireines</artifactId>
        <groupId>fr.gouv.e2.sireines</groupId>
        <version>${revision}</version>
    </parent>

    <artifactId>sireines-deployment</artifactId>
    <packaging>pom</packaging>
    <name>sireines-deployment</name>

    <properties>
        <relative.path.to.parent>..</relative.path.to.parent>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- WAR -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
            <artifactId>sireines-web</artifactId>
            <version>${project.version}</version>
            <type>war</type>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <artifactId>maven-assembly-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <!-- zip des sources -->
                        <id>make-sources</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>single</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <appendAssemblyId>true</appendAssemblyId>
                            <descriptors>
                                <descriptor>assembly-sources.xml</descriptor>
                            </descriptors>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                    <execution>
                        <!-- package général -->
                        <id>make-assembly</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>single</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <appendAssemblyId>false</appendAssemblyId>
                            <descriptors>
                                <descriptor>assembly-zip.xml</descriptor>
                            </descriptors>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

```

> **Chemin relatif** : `sireines-talend/lib/README.md`  
> **Taille** : 620 octets  
> **Lignes** : 12  
> **Type** : markdown

```markdown
importfichiersirene_0_1.jar est généré par Talend.
Il est déclaré en tant que dépendance dans le module sireines-web.
Il peut être modifié. Si sa version évolue, il faut aussi changer sa dépendance dans le pom.xml de sireines-web.

systemRoutines.jar est nécessaire à la compilation.
Il est déclaré en tant que dépendance dans le module sireines-web.
Ne pas y toucher.


Afin de résoudre ces 2 dépendances, il faut les installer sur le répo.
Il suffit pour ça de passer par la phase "initialize" du module sireines-talend.
Donc un maven install sur le module parent "Sireines" devrait faire l'affaire.
```

### 📄 `sireines-talend/pom.xml` [3.323 octets]
<a id="sireines-talend-pom-xml"></a> [↩ Retour à l'arborescence](#tree-sireines-talend-pom-xml)

> **Chemin relatif** : `sireines-talend/pom.xml`  
> **Taille** : 3.323 octets

> **Type** : xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/maven-v4_0_0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <artifactId>sireines</artifactId>
        <groupId>fr.gouv.e2.sireines</groupId>
        <version>${revision}</version>
    </parent>

    <artifactId>sireines-talend</artifactId>
    <packaging>pom</packaging>
    <name>sireines-talend</name>

    <properties>
        <relative.path.to.parent>..</relative.path.to.parent>
    </properties>

    <build>
        <plugins>

            <!--  Installation du jar contenant les jobs Talend  -->
            <!--  Lancer ce goal permet de résoudre la dépendance importfichiersirene du module sireines-web.  -->
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-install-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>Install importfichiersirene JAR dep</id>
                        <phase>initialize</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>install-file</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
                            <artifactId>importfichiersirene</artifactId>
                            <version>0.1</version>
                            <packaging>jar</packaging>
                            <file>${basedir}/lib/importfichiersirene_0_1.jar</file>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                    <!--  Routines de Talend  -->
                    <execution>
                        <id>Install systemRoutines JAR dep</id>
                        <phase>initialize</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>install-file</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <groupId>${project.groupId}</groupId>
                            <artifactId>systemRoutines</artifactId>
                            <version>1.0</version>
                            <packaging>jar</packaging>
                            <file>${basedir}/lib/systemRoutines.jar</file>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>

            <!--  Création du ZIP  -->
            <plugin>
                <artifactId>maven-assembly-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>make-assembly</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>single</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
                <configuration>
                    <appendAssemblyId>false</appendAssemblyId>
                    <descriptors>
                        <descriptor>assembly.xml</descriptor>
                    </descriptors>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	to_char(dos.date_comite, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_comite,
	agt.nom,
	agt.prenom,
	cog.libelle_court as corps_grade,
	to_char(agt.date_naissance, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_naissance,
	str.libelle_court,
	to_char(dos.date_recep_dossier, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_recep_dossier,
	to_char(dos.date_envoi_pres, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_envoi_pres,
	concat(rap1.nom, ' ', rap1.prenom) as rapporteur,
	concat(rap2.nom, ' ', rap2.prenom) as rapporteur2,
	to_char(dos.date_envoi_rapp, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_envoi_rapp,
	dos.si_rap_eval_recu,
	qua.libelle as qualification,
	dos.annee_qualif,
	rem.contenu as remarques,
	to_char(dos.date_decision, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_decision,
	to_char(dos.date_info, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_info,
	fic_avis.contenu as fiche_conc_avis,
	fic_cproj.contenu as fiche_conc_cproj,
	fic_pind.contenu as fiche_conc_pind,
	fic_ccl.contenu as fiche_conc_ccl,
	dos.suivi_modif,
	qua_ren.libelle as renouvellement,
	to_char(dos.date_renouv, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_renouv

FROM 
	comite_domaine com
	INNER JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id
	
	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id
	
	LEFT JOIN rapporteur rap1
	ON rap1.rap_id = dos.rap_id_principal
	
	LEFT JOIN rapporteur rap2
	ON rap2.rap_id = dos.rap_id_secondaire
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ren
	ON qua_ren.qua_id = dos.qua_id_renouvellement
	
	LEFT JOIN remarques rem
	ON rem.dos_id = dos.dos_id
	
	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_avis
	ON fic_avis.fic_id = dos.fic_id_avis

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_cproj
	ON fic_cproj.fic_id = dos.fic_id_cproj

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_pind
	ON fic_pind.fic_id = dos.fic_id_pind

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_ccl
	ON fic_ccl.fic_id = dos.fic_id_ccl
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id

WHERE 	(com.com_cd = ? or ? = 'ALL')
	and dos.date_comite >= ?
	and dos.date_comite <= ?

ORDER BY com.libelle, dos.date_comite, dos.date_recep_dossier]]></xml-property>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	coalesce(the1.libelle, mcl1.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_1,
	coalesce(the2.libelle, mcl2.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_2,
	coalesce(the3.libelle, mcl3.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_3,
	coalesce(the4.libelle, mcl4.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_4,
	coalesce(the5.libelle, mcl5.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_5,
	dos.mot_cle_sup,
	qua.libelle as qualification,
	dos.annee_qualif,
	gen.abrev,
	agt.nom,
	agt.prenom,
	str.libelle_court,
	dos.service,
	dos.mail_agent,
	to_char(dos.date_decision, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_decision

FROM 	
	comite_domaine com
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id
	
	LEFT JOIN genre gen
	ON gen.gen_cd = agt.gen_cd
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	on qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1
	ON mcl1.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the1
	ON (the1.the_id = mcl1.the_id or the1.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2
	ON mcl2.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the2
	ON (the2.the_id = mcl2.the_id or the2.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3
	ON mcl3.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the3
	ON (the3.the_id = mcl3.the_id or the3.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4
	ON mcl4.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the4
	ON (the4.the_id = mcl4.the_id or the4.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5
	ON mcl5.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the5
	ON (the5.the_id = mcl5.the_id or the5.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
and (dos.date_decision + interval '4 years') >= (?) 
and dos.date_decision <= (?)
ORDER BY com.libelle, agt.nom]]></xml-property>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	agt.nom,
	agt.prenom,
	gen.abrev,
	cog.libelle as corps_grade,
	to_char(agt.date_naissance, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_naissance,
	com.libelle as comite,
	qua.libelle as qualification,
	coalesce(the1.libelle, mcl1.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_1,
	coalesce(the2.libelle, mcl2.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_2,
	coalesce(the3.libelle, mcl3.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_3,
	coalesce(the4.libelle, mcl4.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_4,
	coalesce(the5.libelle, mcl5.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_5,
	dos.mot_cle_sup,
	dos.annee_qualif,
	str.libelle_court,
	dos.service,
	dos.mail_agent,
	to_char(dos.date_decision, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_decision,
	dos.referent_rh,
	dos.charge_mission_corps,
	concat(ges.prenom , ' ', ges.nom) as gestionnaire,
	rem.contenu as remarques
	
FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id
	
	LEFT JOIN genre gen
	ON agt.gen_cd = gen.gen_cd
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN gestionnaire ges
	ON ges.ges_id = dos.ges_id
	
	LEFT JOIN remarques rem
	ON rem.dos_id = dos.dos_id
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1
	ON mcl1.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2
	ON mcl2.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3
	ON mcl3.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4
	ON mcl4.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5
	ON mcl5.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the1
	ON (the1.the_id = mcl1.the_id or the1.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1)
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the2
	ON (the2.the_id = mcl2.the_id or the2.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2)
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the3
	ON (the3.the_id = mcl3.the_id or the3.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3)
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the4
	ON (the4.the_id = mcl4.the_id or the4.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4)
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the5
	ON (the5.the_id = mcl5.the_id or the5.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and (?) <= dos.date_decision
	and (?) >= (dos.date_decision + interval '4 years')
	and dos.date_decision + interval '4 years' < current_date + interval '6 months'
	--and dos.date_decision + interval '4 years' > current_date

ORDER BY agt.nom]]></xml-property>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT agt.matricule,
	agt.nom,
	agt.prenom,
	gen.abrev,
	cog.libelle_court as corps_grade,
	to_char(agt.date_naissance, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_naissance,
	str.libelle_court,
	dos.service,
	dos.poste,
	dos.mail_agent,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	com.libelle as comite,
	qua.libelle as qualif,
	qua_ren.libelle as renouvellement,
	to_char(dos.date_renouv, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_renouv,
	coalesce(the1.libelle, mcl1.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_1,
	coalesce(the2.libelle, mcl2.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_2,
	coalesce(the3.libelle, mcl3.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_3,
	coalesce(the4.libelle, mcl4.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_4,
	coalesce(the5.libelle, mcl5.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_5,
	dos.mot_cle_sup,
	dos.annee_qualif,
	dos.si_comp_crit,
	dos.si_comp_rare,
	dos.si_formateur,
	to_char(dos.date_comite, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_comite,
	to_char(dos.date_recep_dossier, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_recep_dossier,
	dos.dossier_agent,
	dos.si_trav_signif,
	to_char(dos.date_envoi_pres, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_envoi_pres,
	concat(rap.nom, ' ', rap.prenom) as rapporteur,
	concat(rap2.nom, ' ', rap2.prenom) as rapporteur2,
	rap.mail,
	to_char(dos.date_envoi_rapp, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_envoi_rapp,
	dos.si_rap_eval_recu,
	dos.rapport_evaluation,
	to_char(dos.date_decision, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_decision,
	to_char(dos.date_info, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_info,
	fic_avis.contenu as avis,
	fic_cproj.contenu as cproj,
	fic_pind.contenu as pind,
	fic_ccl.contenu as ccl,
	dos.suivi_modif,
	dos.decision,
	dos.courrier,
	rem.contenu as remarques,
	dos.adresse_1,
	dos.adresse_2,
	dos.adresse_3,
	dos.MIGT,
	dos.referent_rh,
	dos.charge_mission_corps,
	concat(ges.nom, ' ', ges.prenom) as gestionnaire

FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id
	
	LEFT JOIN genre gen
	ON gen.gen_cd = agt.gen_cd
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ren
	ON qua_ren.qua_id = dos.qua_id_renouvellement
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1
	ON mcl1.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the1
	ON (the1.the_id = mcl1.the_id or the1.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2
	ON mcl2.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the2
	ON (the2.the_id = mcl2.the_id or the2.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3
	ON mcl3.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the3
	ON (the3.the_id = mcl3.the_id or the3.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4
	ON mcl4.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the4
	ON (the4.the_id = mcl4.the_id or the4.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5
	ON mcl5.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the5
	ON (the5.the_id = mcl5.the_id or the5.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)

	LEFT JOIN rapporteur rap
	ON rap.rap_id = dos.rap_id_principal

	LEFT JOIN rapporteur rap2
	ON rap2.rap_id = dos.rap_id_secondaire

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_avis
	ON fic_avis.fic_id = dos.fic_id_avis

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_cproj
	ON fic_cproj.fic_id = dos.fic_id_cproj

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_pind
	ON fic_pind.fic_id = dos.fic_id_pind

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_ccl
	ON fic_ccl.fic_id = dos.fic_id_ccl

	LEFT JOIN remarques rem
	ON rem.dos_id = dos.dos_id

	LEFT JOIN gestionnaire ges
	on ges.ges_id = dos.ges_id
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id = str.mst_id

WHERE (dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	or dos.date_decision is null)
	and (dos.date_recep_dossier >= (?) 
	and dos.date_recep_dossier <= (?)
	or dos.date_recep_dossier is null)]]></xml-property>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A+/A' else 'B+/B' end as macro_grade,
	cor.libelle_court as corps,
	cog.libelle_court as grade,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nd_spe,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expin,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua

FROM  corps cor
	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	and (com.com_cd = ? OR ? = 'ALL')
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A+/A' else 'B+/B' end, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court

ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A+/A' else 'B+/B' end, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court;
]]></xml-property>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT com.libelle,
	com.com_cd,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_spe,
	count(qua_e.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_ei.qua_id) as nb_exp_int,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua,
	count(qua_ch_senior.qua_id) as nb_ch_senior,
	count(qua_ch_conf.qua_id) as nb_ch_conf,
	count(qua_ch.qua_id) as nb_ch,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua_cesaar,
	count(dos.dos_id) as total_dossier,
	count(distinct dos.date_comite) as nb_seances,
	count(dos.qua_id_renouvellement) as nb_renouv,	
	case when com.com_cd = 'CESAR' then 1 else 0 end as is_last
	

FROM comite_domaine com
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id 

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI' and qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_e
	ON qua_e.qua_cd = 'EXPER' and qua_e.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ei
	ON qua_ei.qua_cd = 'EXPIN' and qua_ei.qua_id = dos.qua_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ch
	ON qua_ch.qua_cd = 'CHERC' and qua_ch.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ch_conf
	ON qua_ch_conf.qua_cd = 'CHECO' and qua_ch_conf.qua_id = dos.qua_id
			
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ch_senior
	ON qua_ch_senior.qua_cd = 'CHESE' and qua_ch_senior.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA' and qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, com.com_cd

ORDER BY is_last, com.libelle;]]></xml-property>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT str.libelle_court,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_spe,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expin,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua,
	count(qua_norec.qua_id) as nb_norec
	

FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_norec
	ON qua_norec.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_norec.qua_cd = 'NOREC'
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	and (com.com_cd = ? OR ? = 'ALL')
	and (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+')

GROUP BY str.libelle_court

ORDER BY str.libelle_court;]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT str.libelle_court,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_spe,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expin,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua,
	count(qua_norec.qua_id) as nb_norec
	

FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_norec
	ON qua_norec.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_norec.qua_cd = 'NOREC'

	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id

	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	and (com.com_cd = ? OR ? = 'ALL')
	and (cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+')

GROUP BY str.libelle_court

ORDER BY str.libelle_court;]]></xml-property>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_spe,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expin,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua,
	count(qua_norec.qua_id) as nb_norec
	

FROM dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id = str.mst_id
	
	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_norec
	ON qua_norec.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_norec.qua_cd = 'NOREC'

	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	and (com.com_cd = ? OR ? = 'ALL')
	and (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+')

GROUP BY mst.libelle

ORDER BY case when mst.libelle = 'AUTRES' then 1 else 0 end, mst.libelle;]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_spe,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expin,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua,
	count(qua_norec.qua_id) as nb_norec
	

FROM dossier dos
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id = str.mst_id
	
	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_norec
	ON qua_norec.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_norec.qua_cd = 'NOREC'

	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	and (com.com_cd = ? OR ? = 'ALL')
	and (cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+')

GROUP BY mst.libelle

ORDER BY case when mst.libelle = 'AUTRES' then 1 else 0 end, mst.libelle;]]></xml-property>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT coalesce(mst.libelle, '') as macro_str, str.libelle_court as hybride,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_spe,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expin,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua,
	count(qua_norec.qua_id) as nb_norec
	

FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_norec
	ON qua_norec.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_norec.qua_cd = 'NOREC'
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id

	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	and (com.com_cd = ? OR ? = 'ALL')
	and (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+')

GROUP BY mst.libelle, str.libelle_court

ORDER BY coalesce(mst.libelle, ''), str.libelle_court;]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT coalesce(mst.libelle, '') as macro_str, str.libelle_court as hybride,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_spe,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expin,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_noqua,
	count(qua_norec.qua_id) as nb_norec
	

FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_norec
	ON qua_norec.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_norec.qua_cd = 'NOREC'
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id

	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (str.libelle_court IN ('666')) OR  'all_str' = 'ALL' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('999')) OR 'all_mst' = 'ALL' )
	and dos.date_decision >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	and (com.com_cd = ? OR ? = 'ALL')
	and (cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+')

GROUP BY mst.libelle, str.libelle_court

ORDER BY coalesce(mst.libelle, ''), str.libelle_court;]]></xml-property>
```

```text
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">7</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_agts_femmes_non_actif</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_agts_femmes_non_actif</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT age, qua.libelle as qualification,
	count(dos.dos_id) as nb_dossiers,
	count(distinct case when agt.si_actif is true and agt.gen_cd = 'M' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_agts_hommes_actif,
	count(distinct case when agt.si_actif is true and agt.gen_cd = 'F' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_agts_femmes_actif,
	count(distinct case when agt.si_actif is not true and agt.gen_cd = 'M' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_agts_hommes_non_actif,
	count(distinct case when agt.si_actif is not true and agt.gen_cd = 'F' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_agts_femmes_non_actif

	FROM generate_series(cast (extract (year from current_date) as int) - cast (extract(year from (select max(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt)) as int),
			 cast (extract (year from current_date) as int)  - cast (extract(year from (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt)) as int )) age
	
	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON (cast (extract (year from current_date) as int )) - (cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int )) = age
	
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.agt_id = agt.agt_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE 1=1
	AND (com.com_cd IN ('666') OR 'all_com' = 'ALL')
	and (dos.date_decision + interval '4 years') >= (?) 
	and dos.date_decision <= (?)
	AND (qua.libelle = ? OR ? = 'ALL')
	
	GROUP BY age, qua.libelle
	ORDER BY age
	
	


	
					  
					  ]]></xml-property>

  <Script>importPackage(Packages.java.lang);&#xD;
&#xD;
/**&#xD;
 * Called before rendering each label on a given Axis.&#xD;
 * &#xD;
 * @param axis&#xD;
 *            Axis&#xD;
 * @param label&#xD;
 *            Label&#xD;
 * @param icsc&#xD;
 *            IChartScriptContext&#xD;
 */&#xD;
&#xD;
&#xD;
function beforeDrawAxisLabel( axis, label, icsc )&#xD;
{&#xD;
	if(label.getCaption().getValue() &lt; 0 )&#xD;
		label.getCaption().setValue(label.getCaption().getValue()*(-1))&#xD;
}&#xD;
&#xD;
&#xD;


/**
 * Called before drawing the legend item.
 * 
 * @param lerh
 * 			  LegendEntryRenderingHints
 * @param bounds
 * 			  Bounds
 * @param icsc
 * 			  IChartScriptContext
 * @since Version 2.2.0
 */
&#xD;
// on modifie dynamiquement la valeur de la légende
function beforeDrawLegendItem( lerh, bounds, icsc )
{&#xD;
	// Modifie le libelle de la légende&#xD;
	var quaLibelle = icsc.getExternalContext().getScriptable().getPersistentGlobalVariable(&quot;quaLibelle&quot;);&#xD;
	quaLibelle = quaLibelle.substring(0,1).toUpperCase() + quaLibelle.substring(1);&#xD;
	lerh.getLabel().getCaption().setValue(quaLibelle);
}
/**
 * Called before drawing each datapoint graphical representation or marker.
 * 
 * @param dph
 *            DataPointHints
 * @param fill
 *            Fill
 * @param icsc
 *            IChartScriptContext
 */

function beforeDrawDataPoint( dph, fill, icsc )
{&#xD;
	var orthValue = dph.getOrthogonalDisplayValue();&#xD;
	if(orthValue &lt; 0)&#xD;
		dph.setOrthogonalValue(orthValue*(-1));
}</Script>

  <Script>
/**
 * Called before drawing each datapoint graphical representation or marker.
 * 
 * @param dph
 *            DataPointHints
 * @param fill
 *            Fill
 * @param icsc
 *            IChartScriptContext
 */
 
// applying color to chart
importPackage(Packages.org.eclipse.birt.chart.model.attribute.impl);
function beforeDrawDataPoint( dph, fill, icsc )
{
	if (fill.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ColorDefinitionImpl)){
		fill.set(255, 182, 193);
	}
}


/**
 * Called before drawing the legend item.
 * 
 * @param lerh
 * 			  LegendEntryRenderingHints
 * @param bounds
 * 			  Bounds
 * @param icsc
 * 			  IChartScriptContext
 * @since Version 2.2.0
 */
importPackage(Packages.java.lang);
function beforeDrawLegendItem( lerh, bounds, icsc )
{

	// on change la couleur d'affichage
	var fill = lerh.getFill();
	if (fill.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ColorDefinitionImpl)){
		fill.set(255, 182, 193);
	}


	// Modifie le libelle de la légende
	var quaLibelle = icsc.getExternalContext().getScriptable().getPersistentGlobalVariable(&quot;quaLibelle&quot;);
	quaLibelle = quaLibelle.substring(0,1).toUpperCase() + quaLibelle.substring(1); 
	lerh.getLabel().getCaption().setValue(quaLibelle);
}</Script>
```

```text
            <list-property name="resultSet"/>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT ann,
	count(qua_spe_f.qua_id) as nb_spe_f,
	count(qua_exp_f.qua_id) as nb_exp_f,
	count(qua_expin_f.qua_id) as nb_expin_f,
	count(qua_noqua_f.qua_id) as nb_noqua_f,
	count(qua_spe_g.qua_id) as nb_spe_g,
	count(qua_exp_g.qua_id) as nb_exp_g,
	count(qua_expin_g.qua_id) as nb_expin_g,
	count(qua_noqua_g.qua_id) as nb_noqua_g

FROM generate_series(1940,1990) ann
	LEFT JOIN agent agt
	ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM agt.date_naissance) = ann
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON (? = -1 or com.com_id = ?)
	
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_f
	ON dos_f.agt_id = agt.agt_id and agt.gen_cd = 'F' and dos_f.com_id = com.com_id
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_g
	ON dos_g.agt_id = agt.agt_id and agt.gen_cd = 'M' and dos_g.com_id = com.com_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe_f
	ON qua_spe_f.qua_id = dos_f.qua_id and qua_spe_f.qua_cd = 'SPECI'
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe_g
	ON qua_spe_g.qua_id = dos_g.qua_id and qua_spe_g.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp_f
	ON qua_exp_f.qua_id = dos_f.qua_id and qua_exp_f.qua_cd = 'EXPER'
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp_g
	ON qua_exp_g.qua_id = dos_g.qua_id and qua_exp_g.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin_f
	ON qua_expin_f.qua_id = dos_f.qua_id and qua_expin_f.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin_g
	ON qua_expin_g.qua_id = dos_g.qua_id and qua_expin_g.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua_f
	ON qua_noqua_f.qua_id = dos_f.qua_id and qua_noqua_f.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua_g
	ON qua_noqua_g.qua_id = dos_g.qua_id and qua_noqua_g.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
GROUP BY ann

ORDER BY ann
;]]></xml-property>

                </structure>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT	tmp.libelle_mot_cle,
	tmp.libelle_cd,
	tmp.is_thesaurus,
	tmp.com_id,
	count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) as nb_occurrences_mcl, -- nombre d'occurrences du mot cle par comite de domaine
	(select count(1) from dossier dos where dos.com_id=tmp.com_id) as nb_dossiers

FROM (

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.date_decision,
		the.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN thesaurus the
	ON (the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

	union

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.date_decision,
		mcl.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the
		ON the.the_id = mcl.the_id
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is not null

	union

	SELECT	mcl.libelle_autre as libelle_mot_cle,
		false as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.date_decision,
		null as the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is null and mcl.libelle_autre is not null

) tmp

WHERE tmp.date_decision >= ? and tmp.date_decision <= ?
	AND (tmp.com_cd in ('666') OR 'all_com' = 'ALL')
	AND CASE WHEN ? = false THEN tmp.is_thesaurus ELSE not tmp.is_thesaurus END
GROUP BY tmp.libelle_mot_cle, tmp.com_id, tmp.libelle_cd, tmp.the_id, tmp.is_thesaurus
ORDER BY count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) desc, tmp.libelle_mot_cle;]]></xml-property>

                <structure>

                <structure>

                </structure>
                <structure>
```

```text
                    <property name="name">nb_exp</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_exp</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expin</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expin</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT ann,
	count(dos.dos_id) as tot,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_spe,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_exp,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expin

FROM generate_series(cast (extract(YEAR from(SELECT min(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int),
		cast (extract(YEAR from (SELECT max(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int)) ann
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON extract(YEAR from dos.date_decision) = ann
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
WHERE (com.com_cd IN ('666') OR 'all_com' = 'ALL')

GROUP BY ann

ORDER BY ann;]]></xml-property>
```

```text
/**
 * Called before rendering each label on a given Axis.
 * 
 * @param axis
 *            Axis
 * @param label
 *            Label
 * @param icsc
 *            IChartScriptContext
 */

function beforeDrawAxisLabel( axis, label, icsc )
{
if(label.getCaption().getValue()&lt;0)
label.getCaption().setValue(label.getCaption().getValue()*(-1))
}
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	gen.abrev as agent_genre,
	agt.nom as agent_nom,
	agt.prenom as agent_prenom,
	to_char(agt.date_naissance, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as agent_date_naissance,
	cog.libelle_court as agent_corps_grade,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	qua.libelle as qualification,
	com.libelle as comite,
	dos.annee_qualif as annee_qualification,	
	to_char(dos.date_comite, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_seance,
	to_char(dos.date_decision, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_decision,
	qua_ren.libelle as qualification_precedente,
	to_char(dos.date_renouv, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_qualification_precedente,
	fic_avis.contenu as fiche_conclusion_avis_evolution,
	fic_cproj.contenu as fiche_conclusion_conseil_parcours_professionnel,
	fic_pind.contenu as fiche_conclusion_conseil_formation,
	fic_ccl.contenu as fiche_conclusion_commentaires,
	rem.contenu as remarques,
	concat(rap1.nom, ' ', rap1.prenom) as rapporteur,
	concat(rap2.nom, ' ', rap2.prenom) as rapporteur_2,
	dos.suivi_modif as suivi_modification,
	to_char(dos.date_recep_dossier, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_reception_dossier,
	to_char(dos.date_envoi_pres, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_envoi_president,
	to_char(dos.date_envoi_rapp, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_envoi_rapporteur,			
	dos.si_rap_eval_recu as rapport_evaluateur_recu,
	to_char(dos.date_info, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_information				

FROM 
	comite_domaine com
	INNER JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id
	
	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id

	LEFT JOIN genre gen
	ON gen.gen_cd = agt.gen_cd
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id
	
	LEFT JOIN rapporteur rap1
	ON rap1.rap_id = dos.rap_id_principal
	
	LEFT JOIN rapporteur rap2
	ON rap2.rap_id = dos.rap_id_secondaire
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ren
	ON qua_ren.qua_id = dos.qua_id_renouvellement
	
	LEFT JOIN remarques rem
	ON rem.dos_id = dos.dos_id
	
	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_avis
	ON fic_avis.fic_id = dos.fic_id_avis

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_cproj
	ON fic_cproj.fic_id = dos.fic_id_cproj

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_pind
	ON fic_pind.fic_id = dos.fic_id_pind

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_ccl
	ON fic_ccl.fic_id = dos.fic_id_ccl
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id = str.mst_id

WHERE 	com.com_cd = ? 
	and dos.date_comite >= ?
	and dos.date_comite <= ?
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )

ORDER BY com.libelle, dos.date_comite, dos.date_recep_dossier]]></xml-property>
            <xml-property name="designerValues"><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model:DesignValues xmlns:design="http://www.eclipse.org/datatools/connectivity/oda/design" xmlns:model="http://www.eclipse.org/birt/report/model/adapter/odaModel">
  <Version>2.0</Version>
  <design:ResultSets derivedMetaData="true">
    <design:resultSetDefinitions>
      <design:resultSetColumns>
        <design:resultColumnDefinitions>
          <design:attributes>

              <design:name>comite</design:name>
```

```text
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT com.libelle as comite_libelle,
	com.com_cd as comite_code,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as nb_dossiers_examines,
	count(distinct dos.date_comite) as nb_seances,
	count(dos.qua_id_renouvellement) as nb_renouvellement

FROM comite_domaine com
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id 

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif::text IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, com.com_cd

ORDER BY com.libelle;]]></xml-property>
```
