            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	gen.abrev as agent_genre,
	agt.nom as agent_nom,
	agt.prenom as agent_prenom,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	dos.service as service_affectation,
	qua.libelle as qualification,
	dos.annee_qualif as annee_qualification,
	to_char(dos.date_decision, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_decision,
	to_char(dos.date_decision + interval '4 years' - interval '1 day', 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_fin_validation_qualification,
	coalesce(the1.libelle, mcl1.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_1,
	coalesce(the2.libelle, mcl2.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_2,
	coalesce(the3.libelle, mcl3.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_3,
	coalesce(the4.libelle, mcl4.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_4,
	coalesce(the5.libelle, mcl5.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_5,
	dos.mot_cle_sup as mot_cle_hors_thesaurus,
	dos.mail_agent as agent_mail

FROM 	
	comite_domaine com
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id
	
	LEFT JOIN genre gen
	ON gen.gen_cd = agt.gen_cd
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	on qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1
	ON mcl1.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the1
	ON (the1.the_id = mcl1.the_id or the1.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2
	ON mcl2.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the2
	ON (the2.the_id = mcl2.the_id or the2.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3
	ON mcl3.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the3
	ON (the3.the_id = mcl3.the_id or the3.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4
	ON mcl4.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the4
	ON (the4.the_id = mcl4.the_id or the4.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5
	ON mcl5.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the5
	ON (the5.the_id = mcl5.the_id or the5.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
and (dos.date_decision + interval '4 years') >= NOW()
and ( dos.qua_id NOT IN (SELECT qua2.qua_id from qualification qua2 where qua2.qua_cd like 'NO%') )
ORDER BY com.libelle, agt.nom]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	gen.abrev as agent_genre,
	agt.nom as agent_nom,
	agt.prenom as agent_prenom,
	to_char(agt.date_naissance, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as agent_date_naissance,
	cog.libelle_court as agent_corps_grade,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,	
	dos.service as service_affectation,
	qua.libelle as qualification,
	com.libelle as comite,
	dos.annee_qualif as annee_qualification,
	to_char(dos.date_decision, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_decision,
	coalesce(the1.libelle, mcl1.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_1,
	coalesce(the2.libelle, mcl2.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_2,
	coalesce(the3.libelle, mcl3.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_3,
	coalesce(the4.libelle, mcl4.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_4,
	coalesce(the5.libelle, mcl5.libelle_autre,'') as mot_cle_5,
	dos.mot_cle_sup as mot_cle_hors_thesaurus,
	rem.contenu as remarques,
	dos.mail_agent as agent_mail,	
	dos.referent_rh as referent_ressource_humaine,
	dos.charge_mission_corps as charge_mission_corps,	
	concat(ges.nom, ' ', ges.prenom) as gestionnaire
	
FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id
	
	LEFT JOIN genre gen
	ON agt.gen_cd = gen.gen_cd
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN gestionnaire ges
	ON ges.ges_id = dos.ges_id
	
	LEFT JOIN remarques rem
	ON rem.dos_id = dos.dos_id
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1
	ON mcl1.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2
	ON mcl2.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3
	ON mcl3.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4
	ON mcl4.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5
	ON mcl5.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the1
	ON (the1.the_id = mcl1.the_id or the1.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1)
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the2
	ON (the2.the_id = mcl2.the_id or the2.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2)
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the3
	ON (the3.the_id = mcl3.the_id or the3.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3)
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the4
	ON (the4.the_id = mcl4.the_id or the4.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4)
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the5
	ON (the5.the_id = mcl5.the_id or the5.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	and dos.date_decision + interval '4 years' < current_date + interval '6 months'
	and dos.date_decision + interval '4 years' > current_date
	and ( dos.qua_id NOT IN (SELECT qua2.qua_id from qualification qua2 where qua2.qua_cd like 'NO%') )

ORDER BY agt.nom]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT agt.matricule as agent_matricule,
	gen.abrev as agent_genre,
	agt.nom as agent_nom,
	agt.prenom as agent_prenom,
	to_char(agt.date_naissance, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as agent_date_naissance,
	cog.libelle_court as agent_corps_grade,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	dos.service as service_affectation,
	dos.poste as poste,
	qua.libelle as qualification,
	com.libelle as comite,
	dos.annee_qualif as annee_qualification,
	to_char(dos.date_comite, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_seance,
	to_char(dos.date_decision, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_decision,
	to_char(dos.date_decision + interval '4 years' - interval '1 day', 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_fin_validation_qualification,
	qua_ren.libelle as qualification_precedente,
	to_char(dos.date_renouv, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_qualification_precedente,
	coalesce(the1.libelle, mcl1.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_1,
	coalesce(the2.libelle, mcl2.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_2,
	coalesce(the3.libelle, mcl3.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_3,
	coalesce(the4.libelle, mcl4.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_4,
	coalesce(the5.libelle, mcl5.libelle_autre, '') as mot_cle_5,
	dos.mot_cle_sup as mot_cle_hors_thesaurus,
	dos.si_comp_crit as competence_critique,
	dos.si_comp_rare as competence_rare,
	fic_avis.contenu as fiche_conclusion_avis_evolution,
	fic_cproj.contenu as fiche_conclusion_conseil_parcours_professionnel,
	fic_pind.contenu as fiche_conclusion_conseil_formation,
	fic_ccl.contenu as fiche_conclusion_commentaires,
	dos.si_formateur as formateur,
	dos.si_trav_signif as travaux_significatifs,
	rem.contenu as remarques,
	concat(rap.nom, ' ', rap.prenom) as rapporteur,
	concat(rap2.nom, ' ', rap2.prenom) as rapporteur_2,
	rap.mail as rapporteur_mail,
	dos.suivi_modif as suivi_modification,
	to_char(dos.date_recep_dossier, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_reception_dossier,
	dos.dossier_agent as dossier_agent,
	to_char(dos.date_envoi_pres, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_envoi_president,
	to_char(dos.date_envoi_rapp, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_envoi_rapporteur,
	dos.si_rap_eval_recu as rapport_evaluateur_recu,
	dos.rapport_evaluation as rapport_evaluateur,	
	dos.decision as decision,
	to_char(dos.date_info, 'dd/MM/yyyy') as date_information,
	dos.mail_agent as agent_mail,
	dos.courrier as courrier,
	dos.adresse_1 as agent_adresse_1,
	dos.adresse_2 as agent_adresse_2,
	dos.adresse_3 as agent_adresse_3,
	dos.MIGT as migt,
	dos.referent_rh as referent_ressource_humaine,
	dos.charge_mission_corps as charge_mission_corps,	
	concat(ges.nom, ' ', ges.prenom) as gestionnaire

FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id
	
	LEFT JOIN genre gen
	ON gen.gen_cd = agt.gen_cd
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
	
	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ren
	ON qua_ren.qua_id = dos.qua_id_renouvellement
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1
	ON mcl1.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the1
	ON (the1.the_id = mcl1.the_id or the1.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2
	ON mcl2.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the2
	ON (the2.the_id = mcl2.the_id or the2.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3
	ON mcl3.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the3
	ON (the3.the_id = mcl3.the_id or the3.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4
	ON mcl4.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the4
	ON (the4.the_id = mcl4.the_id or the4.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4)
	
	LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5
	ON mcl5.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5
	
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the5
	ON (the5.the_id = mcl5.the_id or the5.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)

	LEFT JOIN rapporteur rap
	ON rap.rap_id = dos.rap_id_principal

	LEFT JOIN rapporteur rap2
	ON rap2.rap_id = dos.rap_id_secondaire

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_avis
	ON fic_avis.fic_id = dos.fic_id_avis

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_cproj
	ON fic_cproj.fic_id = dos.fic_id_cproj

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_pind
	ON fic_pind.fic_id = dos.fic_id_pind

	LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_ccl
	ON fic_ccl.fic_id = dos.fic_id_ccl

	LEFT JOIN remarques rem
	ON rem.dos_id = dos.dos_id

	LEFT JOIN gestionnaire ges
	on ges.ges_id = dos.ges_id
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id = str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (qua.qua_cd IN ('333')) OR  'all_qua' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));

            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">categorie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">categorie</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>

                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>

            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	cor.libelle_court as corps,
	cog.libelle_court as grade,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court
ORDER BY cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court;
]]></xml-property>

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">corps</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">corps</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">grade</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">grade</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>

                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	cor.libelle_court as corps,
	cog.libelle_court as grade,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court
ORDER BY cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court;
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));

            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">corps</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>

                </structure>
                <structure>

                    <property name="name">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	cor.libelle_court as corps,
	cog.libelle_court as grade,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court
ORDER BY cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court;
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	cor.libelle_court as corps,
	cog.libelle_court as grade,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null  )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court
ORDER BY cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court;
]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>

                </structure>

                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">7</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_dossiers_examines</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_dossiers_examines</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">8</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_seances</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_seances</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">9</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_renouvellement</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_renouvellement</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT com.libelle as comite_libelle,
	com.com_cd as comite_code,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as nb_dossiers_examines,
	count(distinct dos.date_comite) as nb_seances,
	count(dos.qua_id_renouvellement) as nb_renouvellement

FROM comite_domaine com
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id 

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, com.com_cd

ORDER BY com.libelle;]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT com.libelle as comite_libelle,
	com.com_cd as comite_code,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as nb_dossiers_examines,
	count(distinct dos.date_comite) as nb_seances,
	count(dos.qua_id_renouvellement) as nb_renouvellement

FROM comite_domaine com
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.com_id = com.com_id 

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, com.com_cd

ORDER BY com.libelle;]]></xml-property>

                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>

                <structure>

                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1

GROUP BY replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">structure</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">structure</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>

                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>

                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

                <structure>

                <structure>

                <structure>

                <structure>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));

                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>

            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">macro_structure</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">macro_structure</property>

                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_senior</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY mst.libelle
ORDER BY mst.libelle;
]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("222", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_com", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">categorie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">categorie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>
            <xml-property name="designerValues"><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model:DesignValues xmlns:design="http://www.eclipse.org/datatools/connectivity/oda/design" xmlns:model="http://www.eclipse.org/birt/report/model/adapter/odaModel">

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY mst.libelle
ORDER BY mst.libelle;
]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));

            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">categorie</property>

                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>

                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>

                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>

                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_senior</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>

                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_com", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("," ));

                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )

ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT

--		case when agt.date_naissance < '1901-01-01'
--			then (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt where agt.date_naissance > '1901-01-01') 
--			else agt.date_naissance 
--		end ) as int)) as age_qualification,
--	count((dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from 
--		case when agt.date_naissance < '1901-01-01' 
--			then (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt where agt.date_naissance > '1901-01-01') 
--			else agt.date_naissance 
--		end ) as int))) as nb_dossier,
	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int)) as age_qualification,
	count((dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int))) as nb_dossier,
--	count(distinct case when agt.gen_cd = 'M' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_hommes,
--	count(distinct case when agt.gen_cd = 'F' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_femmes,
	count(case when agt.gen_cd = 'M' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_hommes,
	count(case when agt.gen_cd = 'F' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_femmes,
	qua.qua_cd as qualification_code,
	qua.libelle as qualification_libelle

FROM
	dossier dos

	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id

	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1=1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (qua.qua_cd IN ('333')) OR  'all_qua' = 'TOUTES' )
	and CASE 
		WHEN ? = true THEN (dos.date_decision + interval '4 years') >= NOW()
		ELSE 1 = 1
	END

GROUP BY 
--	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from 
--		case when agt.date_naissance < '1901-01-01' 
--			then (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt where agt.date_naissance > '1901-01-01') 
--			else agt.date_naissance 
--		end ) as int)),
	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int)),
	qua.qua_cd,
	qua.libelle

ORDER BY 
--	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from 
--		case when agt.date_naissance < '1901-01-01' 
--			then (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt where agt.date_naissance > '1901-01-01') 
--			else agt.date_naissance 
--		end ) as int))
	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int))
]]></xml-property>

/**&#xD;

 * @param axis&#xD;

 * @param label&#xD;

 * @param icsc&#xD;

 */&#xD;
&#xD;
function beforeDrawAxisLabel( axis, label, icsc )&#xD;
{&#xD;

}&#xD;

                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT 
--	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from 
--		case when agt.date_naissance < '1901-01-01'
--			then (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt where agt.date_naissance > '1901-01-01') 
--			else agt.date_naissance 
--		end ) as int)) as age_qualification,
--	count((dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from 
--		case when agt.date_naissance < '1901-01-01' 
--			then (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt where agt.date_naissance > '1901-01-01') 
--			else agt.date_naissance 
--		end ) as int))) as nb_dossier,
	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int)) as age_qualification,
	count((dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int))) as nb_dossier,
--	count(distinct case when agt.gen_cd = 'M' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_hommes,
--	count(distinct case when agt.gen_cd = 'F' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_femmes,
	count(case when agt.gen_cd = 'M' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_hommes,
	count(case when agt.gen_cd = 'F' then agt.agt_id else null end) as nb_femmes,
	qua.qua_cd as qualification_code,
	qua.libelle as qualification_libelle

FROM
	dossier dos

	INNER JOIN agent agt
	ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua
	ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id

	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1=1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (qua.qua_cd IN ('333')) OR  'all_qua' = 'TOUTES' )
	and CASE 
		WHEN ? = true THEN (dos.date_decision + interval '4 years') >= NOW()
		ELSE 1 = 1
	END

GROUP BY 
--	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from 
--		case when agt.date_naissance < '1901-01-01' 
--			then (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt where agt.date_naissance > '1901-01-01') 
--			else agt.date_naissance 
--		end ) as int)),
	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int)),
	qua.qua_cd,
	qua.libelle

ORDER BY 
--	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from 
--		case when agt.date_naissance < '1901-01-01' 
--			then (select min(agt.date_naissance) from agent agt where agt.date_naissance > '1901-01-01') 
--			else agt.date_naissance 
--		end ) as int))
	(dos.annee_qualif - cast (extract (year from agt.date_naissance) as int))
]]></xml-property>

  <Script>importPackage(Packages.java.lang);&#xD;
&#xD;
/**&#xD;
 * Called before rendering each label on a given Axis.&#xD;
 * &#xD;
 * @param axis&#xD;
 *            Axis&#xD;
 * @param label&#xD;
 *            Label&#xD;
 * @param icsc&#xD;
 *            IChartScriptContext&#xD;
 */&#xD;
&#xD;
function beforeDrawAxisLabel( axis, label, icsc )&#xD;
{&#xD;
	if(label.getCaption().getValue() &lt; 0 )&#xD;
		label.getCaption().setValue(label.getCaption().getValue()*(-1))&#xD;
}&#xD;
</Script>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT	tmp.libelle_mot_cle as libelle_mot_cle,
	tmp.libelle_cd as libelle_comite,
	tmp.is_thesaurus as est_thesaurus,
	tmp.com_id,
	count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) as nb_mot_cle, -- nombre d'occurrences du mot cle par comite de domaine
	(select count(1) from dossier dos where dos.com_id=tmp.com_id) as nb_dossiers

FROM (

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		the.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN thesaurus the
	ON (the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

	union

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		mcl.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the
		ON the.the_id = mcl.the_id
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is not null

	union

	SELECT	mcl.libelle_autre as libelle_mot_cle,
		false as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		null as the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is null and mcl.libelle_autre is not null

) tmp

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( tmp.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (tmp.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and 1 = 1
	AND CASE 
		WHEN ? = 0 THEN tmp.is_thesaurus
		WHEN ? = 1 THEN not tmp.is_thesaurus
		ELSE 1 = 1
	END
	
GROUP BY tmp.libelle_mot_cle, tmp.com_id, tmp.libelle_cd, tmp.the_id, tmp.is_thesaurus
ORDER BY count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) desc, tmp.libelle_mot_cle;]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT	tmp.libelle_mot_cle as libelle_mot_cle,
	tmp.libelle_cd as libelle_comite,
	tmp.is_thesaurus as est_thesaurus,
	tmp.com_id,
	count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) as nb_mot_cle, -- nombre d'occurrences du mot cle par comite de domaine
	(select count(1) from dossier dos where dos.com_id=tmp.com_id) as nb_dossiers

FROM (

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		the.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN thesaurus the
	ON (the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

	union

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		mcl.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the
		ON the.the_id = mcl.the_id
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is not null

	union

	SELECT	mcl.libelle_autre as libelle_mot_cle,
		false as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		null as the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is null and mcl.libelle_autre is not null

) tmp

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( tmp.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (tmp.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and 1 = 1
	AND CASE 
		WHEN ? = 0 THEN tmp.is_thesaurus
		WHEN ? = 1 THEN not tmp.is_thesaurus
		ELSE 1 = 1
	END
	
GROUP BY tmp.libelle_mot_cle, tmp.com_id, tmp.libelle_cd, tmp.the_id, tmp.is_thesaurus
ORDER BY count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) desc, tmp.libelle_mot_cle;]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT	tmp.libelle_mot_cle as libelle_mot_cle,
	tmp.libelle_cd as libelle_comite,
	tmp.is_thesaurus as est_thesaurus,
	tmp.com_id,
	count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) as nb_mot_cle, -- nombre d'occurrences du mot cle par comite de domaine
	(select count(1) from dossier dos where dos.com_id=tmp.com_id) as nb_dossiers

FROM (

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		the.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN thesaurus the
	ON (the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

	union

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		mcl.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the
		ON the.the_id = mcl.the_id
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is not null

	union

	SELECT	mcl.libelle_autre as libelle_mot_cle,
		false as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		null as the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is null and mcl.libelle_autre is not null

) tmp

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( tmp.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (tmp.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (tmp.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and 1 = 1
	AND CASE 
		WHEN ? = 0 THEN tmp.is_thesaurus
		WHEN ? = 1 THEN not tmp.is_thesaurus
		ELSE 1 = 1
	END
	
GROUP BY tmp.libelle_mot_cle, tmp.com_id, tmp.libelle_cd, tmp.the_id, tmp.is_thesaurus
ORDER BY count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) desc, tmp.libelle_mot_cle;]]></xml-property>
            <xml-property name="designerValues"><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model:DesignValues xmlns:design="http://www.eclipse.org/datatools/connectivity/oda/design" xmlns:model="http://www.eclipse.org/birt/report/model/adapter/odaModel">
