                    <property name="nativeName">est_thesaurus</property>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-7</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">com_id</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">com_id</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_mot_cle</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_mot_cle</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_dossiers</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_dossiers</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT	tmp.libelle_mot_cle as libelle_mot_cle,
	tmp.libelle_cd as libelle_comite,
	tmp.is_thesaurus as est_thesaurus,
	tmp.com_id,
	count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) as nb_mot_cle, -- nombre d'occurrences du mot cle par comite de domaine
	(select count(1) from dossier dos where dos.com_id=tmp.com_id) as nb_dossiers

FROM (

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		the.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN thesaurus the
	ON (the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4
		or the.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

	union

	SELECT	the.libelle as libelle_mot_cle,
		true as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		mcl.the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	LEFT JOIN thesaurus the
		ON the.the_id = mcl.the_id
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is not null

	union

	SELECT	mcl.libelle_autre as libelle_mot_cle,
		false as is_thesaurus,
		dos.dos_id,
		dos.annee_qualif,
		null as the_id,
		dos.com_id,
		com.com_cd,
		com.libelle as libelle_cd
	FROM dossier dos
	INNER JOIN mot_cle mcl
	ON (mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1 
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
		or mcl.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5)
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
	WHERE mcl.the_id is null and mcl.libelle_autre is not null

) tmp

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( tmp.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (tmp.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (tmp.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and 1 = 1
	AND CASE 
		WHEN ? = 0 THEN tmp.is_thesaurus
		WHEN ? = 1 THEN not tmp.is_thesaurus
		ELSE 1 = 1
	END
	
GROUP BY tmp.libelle_mot_cle, tmp.com_id, tmp.libelle_cd, tmp.the_id, tmp.is_thesaurus
ORDER BY count(tmp.libelle_mot_cle) desc, tmp.libelle_mot_cle;
]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Sireines</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">categorie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">categorie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as total_dossier

FROM  corps cor

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>

            <property name="dataSource">Sireines</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>

                    <property name="name">annee</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">annee</property>

                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT annee,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as total_dossier

FROM generate_series(cast (extract(YEAR from(SELECT min(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int),
		cast (extract(YEAR from (SELECT max(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int)) annee
	
	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.annee_qualif = annee
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));

            <property name="dataSource">Sireines</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">annee</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">annee</property>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">4</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur</property>

                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_confirme</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>

                    <property name="nativeName">nb_chercheur_senior</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT annee,
	count(qua_cherc.qua_id) as nb_chercheur,
	count(qua_checo.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_confirme,
	count(qua_chese.qua_id) as nb_chercheur_senior,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as total_dossier

FROM generate_series(cast (extract(YEAR from(SELECT min(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int),
		cast (extract(YEAR from (SELECT max(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int)) annee
	
	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.annee_qualif = annee
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_cherc
	ON qua_cherc.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_cherc.qua_cd = 'CHERC'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_checo
	ON qua_checo.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_checo.qua_cd = 'CHECO'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_chese
	ON qua_chese.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_chese.qua_cd = 'CHESE'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOCON'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd = 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )

GROUP BY annee

ORDER BY annee;]]></xml-property>

	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )

GROUP BY annee

ORDER BY annee;]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("222", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_com", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Sireines</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">categorie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">categorie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>

                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as total_dossier

FROM  corps cor

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>
            <xml-property name="designerValues"><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model:DesignValues xmlns:design="http://www.eclipse.org/datatools/connectivity/oda/design" xmlns:model="http://www.eclipse.org/birt/report/model/adapter/odaModel">

            <property name="dataSource">Sireines</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">annee</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">annee</property>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">4</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT annee,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as total_dossier

FROM generate_series(cast (extract(YEAR from(SELECT min(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int),
		cast (extract(YEAR from (SELECT max(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int)) annee
	
	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.annee_qualif = annee
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )

GROUP BY annee

ORDER BY annee;]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT annee,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as total_dossier

FROM generate_series(cast (extract(YEAR from(SELECT min(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int),
		cast (extract(YEAR from (SELECT max(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int)) annee
	
	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.annee_qualif = annee
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str

	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )

GROUP BY annee

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("222", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("','" ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_com", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Sireines</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">annee</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">annee</property>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">4</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">total_dossier</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT annee,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie,
	count(dos.dos_id) as total_dossier

FROM generate_series(cast (extract(YEAR from(SELECT min(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int),
		cast (extract(YEAR from (SELECT max(dos.date_decision)from dossier dos)) as int)) annee
	
	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.annee_qualif = annee
	
	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id
	
WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )

GROUP BY annee

ORDER BY annee;]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("222", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_com", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));
]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">categorie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">categorie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT 
    case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') 
    then 'A/A+' 
    else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif::text IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end ;
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif::text IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY com.libelle, mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') ;
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif::text IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY com.libelle, mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') ;
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT 
	case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') 
	then 'A/A+' 
	else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif::text IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end ;
]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("222", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_com", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>
                    <property name="name">comite</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">2</property>
                    <property name="name">corps</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">corps</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">3</property>
                    <property name="name">grade</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">grade</property>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">12</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">7</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	cor.libelle_court as corps,
	cog.libelle_court as grade,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif::text IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court
ORDER BY com.libelle, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court ;
]]></xml-property>

                    </structure>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("222", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_com", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));

this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	cor.libelle_court as corps,
	cog.libelle_court as grade,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null  )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif::text IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court
ORDER BY com.libelle, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court ;
]]></xml-property>

            <method name="beforeOpen"><![CDATA[this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("111", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("222", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("777", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("888", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("','" ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_year", params["PARAM_Annee"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_com", params["PARAM_Comite"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_mst", params["PARAM_Macro_Structure"].value.join("," ));
this.queryText = this.queryText.replace("all_str", params["PARAM_Structure"].value.join("," ));]]></method>
            <property name="dataSource">Data Source</property>
            <list-property name="resultSet">
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">1</property>

                </structure>
                <structure>

                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">4</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">5</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>
            <xml-property name="designerValues"><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<model:DesignValues xmlns:design="http://www.eclipse.org/datatools/connectivity/oda/design" xmlns:model="http://www.eclipse.org/birt/report/model/adapter/odaModel">

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY com.libelle, mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	mst.libelle as macro_structure,
	replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') as structure,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  dossier dos

	LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ')
ORDER BY com.libelle, mst.libelle, replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ');
]]></xml-property>

            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end as categorie,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end
ORDER BY case when (cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+') then 'A/A+' else 'B/B+' end;
]]></xml-property>

                <structure>

                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">6</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">7</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT
	com.libelle as comite,
	cor.libelle_court as corps,
	cog.libelle_court as grade,
	count(qua_spe.qua_id) as nb_specialiste,
	count(qua_exp.qua_id) as nb_expert,
	count(qua_expin.qua_id) as nb_expert_international,
	count(qua_noqua.qua_id) as nb_non_qualifie

FROM  corps cor

	INNER JOIN corps_grade cog
	ON cor.cor_id = cog.cor_id

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'A' or cog.macro_grade = 'A+' )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court
ORDER BY com.libelle, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court;
]]></xml-property>

	RIGHT JOIN dossier dos
	ON dos.cog_id = cog.cog_id

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_exp
	ON qua_exp.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_exp.qua_cd = 'EXPER'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_expin
	ON qua_expin.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_expin.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_id = dos.qua_id and qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	
	LEFT JOIN structure str
	ON str.str_id = dos.str_id
	
	LEFT JOIN macro_structure mst
	ON mst.mst_id =  str.mst_id
	
	LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com
	ON com.com_id = dos.com_id

WHERE 1 = 1
	and ( com.com_cd <> 'CESAR' )
	and ( cog.macro_grade = 'B' or cog.macro_grade = 'B+' or cog.macro_grade Is Null  )
	and ( (dos.annee_qualif IN ('111')) OR 'all_year' = '9999' )
	and ( (com.com_cd IN ('222')) OR  'all_com' = 'TOUS' )
	and ( (mst.libelle IN ('777')) OR 'all_mst' = 'TOUTES' )
	and ( (replace(str.libelle_court, '''', ' ') IN ('888')) OR  'all_str' = 'TOUTES' )
	
GROUP BY com.libelle, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court
ORDER BY com.libelle, cor.libelle_court, cog.libelle_court;
]]></xml-property>

        <table name="Population Qualifiée Catégorie B" id="273">
            <property name="dataSet">STAT_Population_Corps_Grade_Cat_B</property>
            <list-property name="boundDataColumns">
                <structure>
                    <property name="name">corps</property>
                    <text-property name="displayName">corps</text-property>
                    <expression name="expression" type="javascript">if (dataSetRow["corps"] != null) {&#13;
	dataSetRow["corps"]&#13;
} else {&#13;
	"Sans donnée de Corps"&#13;
}</expression>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="allowExport">true</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="name">grade</property>
                    <text-property name="displayName">grade</text-property>
                    <expression name="expression" type="javascript">if (dataSetRow["grade"] != null) {&#13;
	dataSetRow["grade"]&#13;
} else {&#13;
	"Sans donnée de grade"&#13;
}</expression>
                    <property name="dataType">string</property>
                    <property name="allowExport">true</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="name">nb_specialiste</property>
                    <text-property name="displayName">nb_specialiste</text-property>
                    <expression name="expression" type="javascript">dataSetRow["nb_specialiste"]</expression>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="allowExport">true</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert</property>
                    <text-property name="displayName">nb_expert</text-property>
                    <expression name="expression" type="javascript">dataSetRow["nb_expert"]</expression>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="allowExport">true</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="name">nb_expert_international</property>
                    <text-property name="displayName">nb_expert_international</text-property>
                    <expression name="expression" type="javascript">dataSetRow["nb_expert_international"]</expression>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="allowExport">true</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="name">nb_non_qualifie</property>
                    <text-property name="displayName">nb_non_qualifie</text-property>
                    <expression name="expression" type="javascript">dataSetRow["nb_non_qualifie"]</expression>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="allowExport">true</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="name">total_grade</property>
                    <text-property name="displayName">total_grade</text-property>
                    <expression name="expression" type="javascript">if (params["PARAM_Non_Qualifie"].value == 1) {&#13;
	dataSetRow["nb_specialiste"] + dataSetRow["nb_expert"] + dataSetRow["nb_expert_international"] + dataSetRow["nb_non_qualifie"]&#13;
} else {&#13;
	dataSetRow["nb_specialiste"] + dataSetRow["nb_expert"] + dataSetRow["nb_expert_international"]&#13;
}</expression>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="allowExport">false</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="name">total_specialiste</property>
                    <text-property name="displayName">total_specialiste</text-property>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="aggregateFunction">SUM</property>
                    <list-property name="arguments">

                    <property name="name">nb_seances</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_seances</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">13</property>
                    <property name="name">nb_renouv</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">nb_renouv</property>
                    <property name="dataType">decimal</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">-5</property>
                </structure>
                <structure>
                    <property name="position">14</property>
                    <property name="name">is_last</property>
                    <property name="nativeName">is_last</property>
                    <property name="dataType">integer</property>
                    <property name="nativeDataType">4</property>
                </structure>
            </list-property>
            <xml-property name="queryText"><![CDATA[SELECT com.libelle,
	com.com_cd,
	count(dos_ei.dos_id) as nb_exp_int,
	count(dos_e.dos_id) as nb_exp,
	count(dos_spe.dos_id) as nb_spe,
	count(dos_ch_senior.dos_id) as nb_ch_senior,
	count(dos_ch_conf.dos_id) as nb_ch_conf,
	count(dos_ch.dos_id) as nb_ch,
	count(dos_noqua.dos_id) as nb_noqua,
	count(dos_noqua.dos_id) as nb_noqua_cesaar,
	count(dos_tot.dos_id) as total_dossier,
	count(distinct dos_tot.date_comite) as nb_seances,
	count(dos_renouv.dos_id) as nb_renouv,	
	case when com.com_cd = 'CESAR' then 1 else 0 end as is_last
	

FROM comite_domaine com
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_tot
	ON dos_tot.com_id = com.com_id and extract(YEAR from dos_tot.date_decision) = ?

	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_renouv
	ON dos_renouv.com_id = com.com_id and extract(YEAR from dos_renouv.date_decision) = ? and dos_renouv.renouvellement is not null

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ei
	ON qua_ei.qua_cd = 'EXPIN'
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_ei
	ON dos_ei.com_id = com.com_id and dos_ei.qua_id = qua_ei.qua_id and extract(YEAR from dos_ei.date_decision) = ?

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_e
	ON qua_e.qua_cd = 'EXPER'
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_e
	ON dos_e.com_id = com.com_id and dos_e.qua_id = qua_e.qua_id and extract(YEAR from dos_e.date_decision) = ?

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_spe
	ON qua_spe.qua_cd = 'SPECI'
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_spe
	ON dos_spe.com_id = com.com_id and dos_spe.qua_id = qua_spe.qua_id and extract(YEAR from dos_spe.date_decision) = ?

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ch_senior
	ON qua_ch_senior.qua_cd = 'CHESE'
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_ch_senior
	ON dos_ch_senior.com_id = com.com_id and dos_ch_senior.qua_id = qua_ch_senior.qua_id and extract(YEAR from dos_ch_senior.date_decision) = ?

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ch_conf
	ON qua_ch_conf.qua_cd = 'CHECO'
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_ch_conf
	ON dos_ch_conf.com_id = com.com_id and dos_ch_conf.qua_id = qua_ch_conf.qua_id and extract(YEAR from dos_ch_conf.date_decision) = ?

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_ch
	ON qua_ch.qua_cd = 'CHERC'
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_ch
	ON dos_ch.com_id = com.com_id and dos_ch.qua_id = qua_ch.qua_id and extract(YEAR from dos_ch.date_decision) = ?

	LEFT JOIN qualification qua_noqua
	ON qua_noqua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA'
	LEFT JOIN dossier dos_noqua
	ON dos_noqua.com_id = com.com_id and dos_noqua.qua_id = qua_noqua.qua_id and extract(YEAR from dos_noqua.date_decision) = ?

GROUP BY com.libelle, com.com_cd

ORDER BY is_last, com.libelle;]]></xml-property>

package i2.application.sireines.boot.initializer;

import java.io.Serializable;

import javax.inject.Inject;

import i2.application.sireines.domain.dossier.Seance;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Balise;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.ComiteDomaine;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Corps;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.CorpsGrade;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Extraction;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Genre;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Gestionnaire;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.MacroStructure;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Qualification;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Rapporteur;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.RubriqueExtr;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Structure;
import i2.application.sireines.domain.referentiel.Thesaurus;
import i2.application.sireines.referentiel.MotCleMdl;
import io.vertigo.core.spaces.component.ComponentInitializer;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.domain.metamodel.DtDefinition;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.domain.model.DtListURIForMasterData;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.domain.model.DtObject;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.domain.util.DtObjectUtil;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.store.StoreManager;
import io.vertigo.lang.Assertion;
import io.vertigo.util.StringUtil;

/**
 * Initialisation du manager des masterdatas.
 * @author pchretien
 * @version $Id: PersistenceManagerInitializer.java,v 1.1 2013/07/18 17:36:33 npiedeloup Exp $
 */
public final class PersistenceManagerInitializer implements ComponentInitializer {

	/**
	 * Constante indiquant de selectionner tous les éléments d'une liste de référence.
	 */
	public static final String TOUS = null; // Code pour TOUS = null

	/**
	 * Constante indiquant de selectionner les éléments actifs seulement d'une liste de référence.
	 */
	public static final String ACTIF = "ACTIF"; // Code pour SI_ACTIF = true

	private static final int CACHE_TIME_TO_LIVE_IN_SEC = 3600;

	private static final String SI_ACTIF = "siActif";

	@Inject
	private StoreManager storeManager;

	/** {@inheritDoc} */
	@Override
	public void init() {
		registerMasterData(storeManager, ComiteDomaine.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, ComiteDomaine.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Corps.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Genre.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, MacroStructure.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, MacroStructure.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Structure.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Structure.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, CorpsGrade.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, CorpsGrade.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Qualification.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Rapporteur.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Rapporteur.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Seance.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Balise.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Balise.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Gestionnaire.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Gestionnaire.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, MotCleMdl.class, true);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, MotCleMdl.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Thesaurus.class, true);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, Thesaurus.class, ACTIF, SI_ACTIF, Boolean.TRUE);

		registerMasterData(storeManager, Extraction.class);
		registerMasterData(storeManager, RubriqueExtr.class);
	}

	private static void registerMasterData(final StoreManager storeManager,
			final Class<? extends DtObject> dtObjectClass) {
		registerMasterData(storeManager, dtObjectClass, TOUS, null, null, true, true);
	}

	private static void registerMasterData(final StoreManager storeManager,
			final Class<? extends DtObject> dtObjectClass, final boolean isCacheable) {
		registerMasterData(storeManager, dtObjectClass, TOUS, null, null, true, isCacheable);
	}

	private static void registerMasterData(final StoreManager storeManager,
			final Class<? extends DtObject> dtObjectClass, final String code, final String fieldName,
			final Serializable value) {
		Assertion.checkNotNull(code, "Le code de la MasterDataList doit être non null");
		Assertion.checkArgNotEmpty(fieldName, "Le nom du champs de la MasterDataList à filtrer doit être non null");
		//---------------------------------------------------------------------
		registerMasterData(storeManager, dtObjectClass, code, fieldName, value, true, true);
	}

	private static void registerMasterData(final StoreManager storeManager,
			final Class<? extends DtObject> dtObjectClass, final String code, final String fieldName,
			final Serializable value, final boolean isReloadedByList, final boolean isCacheable) {
		final DtDefinition dtDefinition = DtObjectUtil.findDtDefinition(dtObjectClass);
		if (isCacheable) {
			storeManager.getDataStoreConfig().registerCacheable(dtDefinition, CACHE_TIME_TO_LIVE_IN_SEC,
					isReloadedByList, true);
		}
		final DtListURIForMasterData uri = new DtListURIForMasterData(dtDefinition, code);
		if (StringUtil.isEmpty(fieldName)) {
			storeManager.getMasterDataConfig().register(uri);
		} else {
			storeManager.getMasterDataConfig().register(uri, StringUtil.camelToConstCase(fieldName), value);
		}
	}

}

package i2.application.sireines.boot.manager;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.Map;

import javax.inject.Inject;

import io.vertigo.commons.script.ScriptManager;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.file.FileManager;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.file.model.VFile;
import io.vertigo.lang.Assertion;
import io.vertigo.lang.WrappedException;

/**
 * Implementation de l'interface BirtManager.
 * @author jmosset
 * @version $Id: codetemplates.xml,v 1.2 2011/06/21 14:33:16 npiedeloup Exp $
 */
public class BirtManagerImpl implements BirtManager {
	@Inject
	private BirtMergerPlugin mergerPlugin;

	private final FileManager fileManager;

	/**
	 * Constructeur.
	 * @param scriptManager Manager des scripts
	 * @param fileManagerParam Manager des fichiers
	 */
	@Inject
	public BirtManagerImpl(final ScriptManager scriptManager, final FileManager fileManagerParam) {
		Assertion.checkNotNull(fileManagerParam);
		Assertion.checkNotNull(scriptManager);
		//---------------------------------------------------------------------
		this.fileManager = fileManagerParam;
	}

	/** {@inheritDoc} */
	@Override
	public VFile publish(final String fileName, final URL modelFileURL, final Map<String, Object> data) {
		Assertion.checkNotNull(fileName);
		Assertion.checkNotNull(modelFileURL);
		Assertion.checkNotNull(data);
		//---------------------------------------------------------------------
		try {
			return generateFile(fileName, modelFileURL, data);
		} catch (final IOException e) {
			final String msg = "La génération du fichier a échoué.<!-- " + e.getMessage() + "--> pour le fichier "
					+ fileName;
			throw new WrappedException(msg, e);
		}
	}

	private VFile generateFile(final String fileName, final URL modelFileURL, final Map<String, Object> data)
			throws IOException {
		final File fileToExport = mergerPlugin.execute(modelFileURL, data);
		return fileManager.createFile(fileName, "application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet", fileToExport);
	}
}

package i2.application.sireines.boot.manager;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;

import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Named;

import org.apache.log4j.Logger;
import org.eclipse.birt.core.exception.BirtException;
import org.eclipse.birt.core.framework.Platform;
import org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.api.EXCELRenderOption;
import org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.api.EngineConfig;
import org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.api.EngineException;
import org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.api.IReportEngine;
import org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.api.IReportEngineFactory;
import org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.api.IReportRunnable;
import org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.api.IRunAndRenderTask;
import org.eclipse.birt.report.engine.api.RenderOption;

import io.vertigo.lang.Assertion;
import io.vertigo.lang.Plugin;
import io.vertigo.lang.WrappedException;
import io.vertigo.quarto.publisher.PublisherFormat;

/**
 * Classe BirtMergerPlugin.
 * @author jmosset
 * @version $Id: codetemplates.xml,v 1.2 2011/06/21 14:33:16 npiedeloup Exp $
 */
public class BirtMergerPlugin implements Plugin {

	/** Prefix des fichiers temporaires generes. */
	private static final String TEMP_FILE_PREFIX = "krep";

	/** Suffix des fichiers temporaires generes. */
	private static final String TEMP_FILE_SUFFIX = ".birt";

	private final EngineConfig engineConfig;
	private IReportEngine birtEngine;
	private final String jndiDatabase;

	private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(BirtMergerPlugin.class);

	/**
	 * Constructeur.
	 * @param jndiDatabase Nom de la ressource JNDI a passer aux modeles. 
	 * Une seule ressource pour tous les appels.
	 */
	@Inject
	public BirtMergerPlugin(@Named("jndiDatabase") final String jndiDatabase) {
		this.engineConfig = new EngineConfig();
		this.jndiDatabase = jndiDatabase;
	}

	/**
	 * Action.
	 * @param modelFileURL modelFileURL
	 * @param data data
	 * @return file
	 * @throws IOException IOException
	 */
	public File execute(final URL modelFileURL, final Map<String, Object> data) throws IOException {
		Assertion.checkNotNull(modelFileURL);
		Assertion.checkNotNull(data);
		//---------------------------------------------------------------------
		final File file = new File(modelFileURL.getFile());
		Assertion.checkArgument(file.exists(), "Le fichier du modèle est introuvable");
		Assertion.checkArgument(file.canRead(), "Le fichier du modèle n'est pas lisible");
		if (!file.setReadOnly()) {
			LOG.warn("Impossible de mettre readOnly le fichier modèle " + file.getName());
		}

		// On ajoute l'url du JNDI pour le parametre Database systematiquement.
		data.put("Database", jndiDatabase);

		try {
			return doExecute(file, data);
		} finally {
			if (!file.setWritable(true)) {
				LOG.warn("Impossible de mettre writable le fichier modèle " + file.getName());
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Effectue le traitement.
	 * 
	 * @param modelFile Fichier modele, ce fichier n'est pas modifie.
	 * @param publisherData Parametres des donnees a fusionner 
	 * @return Fichier d'entree modifie par le sous-processor
	 */
	private File doExecute(final File modelFile, final Map<String, Object> publisherData) throws IOException {

		final File retour;

		start();

		try {
			//traitement du modele Birt.
			birtEngine.changeLogLevel(Level.SEVERE);

			//traitement du modele.
			final IReportRunnable design = birtEngine.openReportDesign(modelFile.getAbsolutePath());

			// Creation de la tache de generation du rapport
			final IRunAndRenderTask task = birtEngine.createRunAndRenderTask(design);

			// Gestion des parametres de la task
			if (publisherData != null) {
				task.setParameterValues(publisherData);
			}

			//gestion du rendu des rapport

			//creation d'un fichier temporaire
			retour = executeRenderTask(task);

		} catch (final IOException | EngineException e) {
			throw new WrappedException("Erreur pendant le merging BIRT", e);
		}
		stop();

		return retour;
	}

	/*
	 * Execution de la task de rendu BIRT.
	 */
	private File executeRenderTask(final IRunAndRenderTask task) throws IOException {
		final File fileTemp = File.createTempFile(TEMP_FILE_PREFIX, TEMP_FILE_SUFFIX);
		final OutputStream outputStream = new FileOutputStream(fileTemp);
		try {
			//set des options de rendu
			task.setRenderOption(getRenderOption(outputStream));

			//run de la task
			task.run();
			task.close();
		} catch (final EngineException e) {
			LOG.error("Erreur dans l'execution du runtime BIRT.", e);
			throw new WrappedException("Erreur pendant le merging BIRT", e);
		} finally {
			outputStream.close();
		}
		return fileTemp;
	}

	/*
	 * Gestion du rendu du rapport.
	 */
	private RenderOption getRenderOption(final OutputStream out) {
		final RenderOption options = new EXCELRenderOption();
		options.setOutputFormat("xls");
		options.setOutputStream(out);
		return options;
	}

	private void start() {
		//demarage de la plateforme de rendu birt
		try {
			Platform.startup(engineConfig);
			final IReportEngineFactory factory = (IReportEngineFactory) Platform
					.createFactoryObject(IReportEngineFactory.EXTENSION_REPORT_ENGINE_FACTORY);
			this.birtEngine = factory.createReportEngine(this.engineConfig);

		} catch (final BirtException e) {
			throw new WrappedException("Erreur de lancement de la plateforme BIRT", e);
		}

	}

	private void stop() {
		//arret de la plateforme de rendu BIRT.
		this.birtEngine.destroy();
		Platform.shutdown();
	}

	/**
	 * Récupération des formats autorisés.
	 * @return Format de publication.
	 */
	public PublisherFormat getPublisherFormat() {
		//TODO A terme ODS doit etre possible
		return PublisherFormat.ODT;
	}
}
