```java
package i2.application.sireines.util;

import io.vertigo.dynamo.domain.metamodel.DataType;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.domain.metamodel.Formatter;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.domain.metamodel.FormatterException;
import io.vertigo.dynamox.domain.formatter.Resources;

/**
 * Gestion du formattage minimum.
 * @author jmosset
 * @version $Id: codetemplates.xml,v 1.2 2011/06/21 14:33:16 npiedeloup Exp $
 */
public final class FormatterAnnee implements Formatter {

	/**
	 * Constructor.
	 * @param args Arguments
	 */
	public FormatterAnnee(final String args) {
		//nothing
	}

	/**
	 * {@inheritDoc}
	 */
	@Override
	public String valueToString(final Object objValue, final DataType dataType) {
		if (objValue == null) {
			return "";
		}

		return String.valueOf(objValue);
	}

	/**
	 * {@inheritDoc}
	 */
	@Override
	public Object stringToValue(final String strValue, final DataType dataType) throws FormatterException {
		if (strValue == null || "".equals(strValue)) {
			return null;
		}
		try {
			return Integer.valueOf(strValue);
		} catch (final Exception ex) {
			FormatterException fe = new FormatterException(Resources.DYNAMOX_NUMBER_NOT_FORMATTED); 
			fe.initCause(ex);
			throw fe;
		}
	}

}
```

```java
package io.vertigo.dynamo.plugins.search.elasticsearch.embedded;

import io.vertigo.commons.codec.CodecManager;
import io.vertigo.core.resource.ResourceManager;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.plugins.search.elasticsearch.AbstractESSearchServicesPlugin;
import io.vertigo.lang.Assertion;
import io.vertigo.lang.Option;
import io.vertigo.lang.WrappedException;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.URLDecoder;

import javax.inject.Inject;
import javax.inject.Named;

import org.elasticsearch.client.Client;
import org.elasticsearch.common.settings.ImmutableSettings;
import org.elasticsearch.common.settings.Settings;
import org.elasticsearch.node.Node;
import org.elasticsearch.node.NodeBuilder;

//Vérifier
/**
 * Gestion de la connexion au serveur ElasticSearch en mode embarqué.
 *
 * @author pchretien, npiedeloup
 */
public final class ESEmbeddedSearchServicesPlugin extends AbstractESSearchServicesPlugin {
	/** url du serveur elasticSearch.  */
	private final URL elasticSearchHomeURL;
	private Node node;
	
	private String httpPort;
	private String transportTcpPort;

	/**
	 * Constructeur
	 * @param elasticSearchHome URL du serveur SOLR
	 * @param envIndex Nom de l'index de l'environment
	 * @param rowsPerQuery Nombre d'élément retourné par query
	 * @param codecManager Manager des codecs
	 * @param resourceManager Manager d'accès aux ressources
	 * @param configFile Fichier de configuration des indexs
	 */
	@Inject
	public ESEmbeddedSearchServicesPlugin(@Named("home") final String elasticSearchHome, @Named("envIndex") final String envIndex,
			@Named("rowsPerQuery") final int rowsPerQuery, @Named("config.file") final Option<String> configFile,
			final CodecManager codecManager, final ResourceManager resourceManager, @Named("httpPort") final String httpPort,
			@Named("transportTcpPort") final String transportTcpPort) {
		super(envIndex, rowsPerQuery, configFile, codecManager, resourceManager);
		Assertion.checkArgNotEmpty(elasticSearchHome);
		//-----
		elasticSearchHomeURL = resourceManager.resolve(elasticSearchHome);
		this.httpPort = httpPort;
		this.transportTcpPort = transportTcpPort;
	}

	/** {@inheritDoc} */
	@Override
	protected Client createClient() {
		node = createNode(elasticSearchHomeURL, httpPort, transportTcpPort);
		node.start();
		return node.client();
	}

	/** {@inheritDoc} */
	@Override
	protected void closeClient() {
		node.close();
	}

	private static Node createNode(final URL esHomeURL, final String httpPort, final String transportTcpPort) {
		Assertion.checkNotNull(esHomeURL);
		//-----
		final File home;
		try {
			home = new File(URLDecoder.decode(esHomeURL.getFile(), "UTF-8"));
		} catch (final UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
			throw new WrappedException("Error de parametrage du ElasticSearchHome " + esHomeURL, e);
		}
		Assertion.checkArgument(home.exists() && home.isDirectory(), "Le ElasticSearchHome : {0} n''existe pas, ou n''est pas un répertoire.", home.getAbsolutePath());
		Assertion.checkArgument(home.canWrite(), "L''application n''a pas les droits d''écriture sur le ElasticSearchHome : {0}", home.getAbsolutePath());
		return new NodeBuilder()
				.settings(buildNodeSettings(home.getAbsolutePath(), httpPort, transportTcpPort))
				.local(true)
				.build();
	}

	private static Settings buildNodeSettings(final String homePath, final String httpPort, final String transportTcpPort) {
		//Build settings
		return ImmutableSettings.settingsBuilder()
				.put("node.name", "es-embedded-node-" + System.currentTimeMillis())
				.put("path.home", homePath)
				.put("http.port", httpPort)
				.put("transport.tcp.port", transportTcpPort)
				.build();
	}
}
```

```java
/**
 * <p>
 * This tag works hand in hand with the TableTag to display a list of objects. This describes a column of data in the
 * TableTag. There can be any number of columns that make up the list.
 * </p>
 * <p>
 * This tag does no work itself, it is simply a container of information. The TableTag does all the work based on the
 * information provided in the attributes of this tag.
 * <p>

 * @author Fabrizio Giustina

 */
public class ColumnTag extends BodyTagSupport implements MediaUtil.SupportsMedia {

	/**

	 * called on the current object in the iteration for the given row. The property format is in typical struts format
	 * for properties (required)
	 */

	/**

	 */
	private String title;

	 * by default, null values don't appear in the list, by setting viewNulls to 'true', then null values will appear as

	 * if set to true, then any email addresses and URLs found in the content of the column are automatically converted

	 */

	@Override
	public int doEndTag() throws JspException {

				.findAttribute(TableTag.PAGE_ATTRIBUTE_MEDIA);

			cell = new Cell(this.bodyContent.getString());

		final Object rowStyle = this.attributeMap.get(TagConstants.ATTRIBUTE_STYLE);
		final Object rowClass = this.attributeMap.get(TagConstants.ATTRIBUTE_CLASS);
		if (rowStyle != null || rowClass != null) {
			final HtmlAttributeMap perRowValues = new HtmlAttributeMap();
			if (rowStyle != null) {
				perRowValues.put(TagConstants.ATTRIBUTE_STYLE, rowStyle);
			}
			if (rowClass != null) {
				perRowValues.put(TagConstants.ATTRIBUTE_CLASS, rowClass);
			}
			if (cell == null) {
				cell = new Cell(null);

	/**

	 * called only at first iteration.
	 * @param tableTag parent table tag
	 * @throws DecoratorInstantiationException for error during column decorator instantiation
	 * @throws ObjectLookupException for errors in looking up values
	 */
	private void addHeaderToTable(final TableTag tableTag)
			throws DecoratorInstantiationException, ObjectLookupException {
		// don't modify "title" directly
		String evalTitle = this.title;

		// title has precedence over titleKey
		if (evalTitle == null && (this.titleKey != null || this.property != null)) {
			// handle title i18n
			evalTitle = tableTag.getProperties().geResourceProvider().getResource(this.titleKey, this.property,
					tableTag, this.pageContext);
		}

		final HeaderCell headerCell = new HeaderCell();
		headerCell.setHeaderAttributes((HtmlAttributeMap) this.headerAttributeMap.clone());
		headerCell.setHtmlAttributes((HtmlAttributeMap) this.attributeMap.clone());
		headerCell.setTitle(evalTitle);
		headerCell.setSortable(this.sortable);

		final List decorators = new ArrayList();

		// handle multiple chained decorators, whitespace separated
		if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(this.decorator)) {
			final String[] decoratorNames = StringUtils.split(this.decorator);
			for (int j = 0; j < decoratorNames.length; j++) {
				decorators.add(tableTag.getProperties().getDecoratorFactoryInstance()
						.loadColumnDecorator(this.pageContext, decoratorNames[j]));
			}
		}

		// "special" decorators
		if (this.escapeXml) {
			decorators.add(EscapeXmlColumnDecorator.INSTANCE);
		}
		if (this.autolink) {
			decorators.add(AutolinkColumnDecorator.INSTANCE);
		}
		if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(this.format)) {
			decorators.add(new MessageFormatColumnDecorator(this.format, tableTag.getProperties().getLocale()));
		}

		headerCell.setColumnDecorators(
				(DisplaytagColumnDecorator[]) decorators.toArray(new DisplaytagColumnDecorator[decorators.size()]));

		headerCell.setBeanPropertyName(this.property);
		headerCell.setShowNulls(this.nulls);
		headerCell.setMaxLength(this.maxLength);
		headerCell.setMaxWords(this.maxWords);
		headerCell.setGroup(this.group);
		headerCell.setSortProperty(this.sortProperty);
		headerCell.setTotaled(this.totaled);

		final Comparator headerComparator = (comparator != null) ? comparator
				: tableTag.getProperties().getDefaultComparator();

		headerCell.setComparator(headerComparator);
		headerCell.setDefaultSortOrder(this.defaultorder);
		headerCell.setSortName(this.sortName);

		// href and parameter, create link
		if (this.href != null) {
			Href colHref;

			// empty base url, use href with parameters from parent table
			if (StringUtils.isEmpty(this.href.getBaseUrl())) {
				colHref = (Href) tableTag.getBaseHref().clone();
			} else {
				colHref = (Href) this.href.clone();
			}

			if (this.paramId != null) {
				// parameter value is in a different object than the iterated one
				if (this.paramName != null || this.paramScope != null) {
					// create a complete string for compatibility with previous version before expression evaluation.
					// this approach is optimized for new expressions, not for previous property/scope parameters
					final StringBuffer expression = new StringBuffer();

					// append scope
					if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(this.paramScope)) {
						expression.append(this.paramScope).append("Scope.");
					}

					// base bean name
					if (this.paramId != null) {
						expression.append(this.paramName);
					} else {
						expression.append(tableTag.getName());
					}

					// append property
					if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(this.paramProperty)) {
						expression.append('.').append(this.paramProperty);
					}

					// evaluate expression.
					// note the value is fixed, not based on any object created during iteration
					// this is here for compatibility with the old version mainly
					final Object paramValue = tableTag.evaluateExpression(expression.toString());

					// add parameter
					colHref.addParameter(this.paramId, paramValue);
				} else {
					// set id
					headerCell.setParamName(this.paramId);

					// set property
					headerCell.setParamProperty(this.paramProperty);
				}
			}

			// sets the base href
			headerCell.setHref(colHref);

		}

		tableTag.addColumn(headerCell);

		if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {
			log.debug("columnTag.addHeaderToTable() :: first iteration - adding header " + headerCell);
		}
	}

	/**

	@Override
	public void release() {

		this.headerAttributeMap.clear();
		this.href = null;
		this.maxLength = 0;
		this.maxWords = 0;
		this.nulls = false;
		this.paramId = null;
		this.paramName = null;
		this.paramProperty = null;
		this.paramScope = null;
		this.property = null;
		this.sortable = false;
		this.sortName = null;
		this.supportedMedia = null;
		this.title = null;
		this.titleKey = null;
		this.sortProperty = null;
		this.comparator = null;
		this.defaultorder = null;
		this.escapeXml = true;
		this.format = null;
		this.value = null;
		this.totaled = false;
	}

	/**
	 * @see javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag#doStartTag()
	 */
	@Override
	public int doStartTag() throws JspException {
		final TableTag tableTag = getTableTag();
		if (tableTag == null) {
			throw new TagStructureException(getClass(), "column", "table");
		}

		// If the list is empty, do not execute the body; may result in NPE
		if (tableTag.isEmpty() || !tableTag.isIncludedRow()) {
			return SKIP_BODY;
		}

		final MediaTypeEnum currentMediaType = (MediaTypeEnum) this.pageContext
				.findAttribute(TableTag.PAGE_ATTRIBUTE_MEDIA);
		if (!MediaUtil.availableForMedia(this, currentMediaType)) {
			return SKIP_BODY;
		}

		return super.doStartTag();
	}

	@Override
	public String toString() {

				.append("bodyContent", this.bodyContent) //$NON-NLS-1$
				.append("group", this.group) //$NON-NLS-1$
				.append("maxLength", this.maxLength) //$NON-NLS-1$
				.append("decorator", this.decorator) //$NON-NLS-1$

				.append("paramName", this.paramName) //$NON-NLS-1$
				.append("autolink", this.autolink) //$NON-NLS-1$

				.append("nulls", this.nulls) //$NON-NLS-1$

				.append("sortable", this.sortable) //$NON-NLS-1$
```

```java
package routines.system;

import io.vertigo.app.Home;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.database.SqlDataBaseManager;
import io.vertigo.dynamo.database.connection.SqlConnection;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.apache.commons.logging.Log;
import org.apache.commons.logging.LogFactory;

/**
 * Classe Talend surchargee pour le pasage de connexion Sirene --> Talend job.
 * @author mdefour
 * @version $Id: SharedDBConnection.java 2292 2011-01-14 16:57:54Z lkernalleguen $
 */
public final class SharedDBConnection {

	private static final String SIREINES_CONNECTION_NAME = "sireines";
	private static boolean isModeDebug;
	private static SharedDBConnection instance;
	private final Log log = LogFactory.getLog(getClass());
	private final Map<String, Connection> sharedConnections;

	private SharedDBConnection() {
		sharedConnections = new HashMap<String, Connection>();
	}

	private static synchronized SharedDBConnection getInstance() {
		if (instance == null) {
			instance = new SharedDBConnection();
		}
		return instance;
	}

	private synchronized Connection getConnection(final String dbDriver, final String url, final String userName,
			final String password, final String dbConnectionName) throws ClassNotFoundException, SQLException {
		//Code ajout�e
		if (SIREINES_CONNECTION_NAME.equals(dbConnectionName)) {
			final SqlDataBaseManager dbManager = Home.getApp().getComponentSpace().resolve(SqlDataBaseManager.class);
			final SqlConnection connection = dbManager.getConnectionProvider(
					SqlDataBaseManager.MAIN_CONNECTION_PROVIDER_NAME).obtainConnection();
			return connection.getJdbcConnection();
		}
		//Code Talend
		if (isModeDebug) {
			final Set<String> keySet = sharedConnections.keySet();
			log.debug("SharedDBConnection, current shared connections list is:");
			String key;
			for (final Iterator<String> iterator = keySet.iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); log.debug(" " + key)) {
				key = iterator.next();
			}

			log.debug("");
		}
		Connection connection = sharedConnections.get(dbConnectionName);
		if (connection == null) {
			if (isModeDebug) {
				log.debug("SharedDBConnection, can't find the key:" + dbConnectionName + " "
						+ "so create a new one and share it.");
			}
			Class.forName(dbDriver);
			connection = DriverManager.getConnection(url, userName, password);
			sharedConnections.put(dbConnectionName, connection);
		} else if (connection.isClosed()) {
			if (isModeDebug) {
				log.debug("SharedDBConnection, find the key: " + dbConnectionName + " "
						+ "But it is closed. So create a new one and share it.");
			}
			connection = DriverManager.getConnection(url, userName, password);
			sharedConnections.put(dbConnectionName, connection);
		} else if (isModeDebug) {
			log.debug("SharedDBConnection, find the key: " + dbConnectionName + " " + "it is OK.");
		}
		return connection;
	}

	/**
	 * Retourne la connection JDBC a la base de donnees.
	 * @param dbDriver driver BdD.
	 * @param url url del aconnexion BdD.
	 * @param userName de la connexion.
	 * @param password de la connexion.
	 * @param dbConnectionName Nom de la connexion.
	 * @return Connexion sql.
	 * @throws ClassNotFoundException si la classe du driver n'est pas dans le classpath
	 * @throws SQLException erreur BdD.
	 */
	public static Connection getDBConnection(final String dbDriver, final String url, final String userName,
			final String password, final String dbConnectionName) throws ClassNotFoundException, SQLException {
		final SharedDBConnection instanceLocal = getInstance();
		return instanceLocal.getConnection(dbDriver, url, userName, password, dbConnectionName);
	}

	/**
	 * Remet l'instance a NULL.
	 */
	public static void clear() {
		instance = null;
	}

	/**
	 * Met le param DEBUG a la valeur passee.
	 * @param debug booleen.
	 */
	public static void setDebugMode(final boolean debug) {
		isModeDebug = debug;
	}

}
```

```xml
<ehcache xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="ehcache.xsd">

    <!--
    DiskStore configuration

    Sets the path to the directory where cache files are created.

    If the path is a Java System Property it is replaced by its value in the
    running VM.

    The following properties are translated:
    * user.home - User's home directory
    * user.dir - User's current working directory
    * java.io.tmpdir - Default temp file path

    Subdirectories can be specified below the property e.g. java.io.tmpdir/one
    -->
    <diskStore path="java.io.tmpdir/ehcache/Sireines"/>

    <!--
    Specifies a CacheManagerEventListenerFactory, be used to create a CacheManagerPeerProvider,
    which is notified when Caches are added or removed from the CacheManager.

    The attributes of CacheManagerEventListenerFactory are:
    * class - a fully qualified factory class name
    * properties - comma separated properties having meaning only to the factory.

    Sets the fully qualified class name to be registered as the CacheManager event listener.

    The events include:
    * adding a Cache
    * removing a Cache

    Callbacks to listener methods are synchronous and unsynchronized. It is the responsibility
    of the implementer to safely handle the potential performance and thread safety issues
    depending on what their listener is doing.

    If no class is specified, no listener is created. There is no default.
    -->
    <cacheManagerEventListenerFactory class="" properties=""/>


    <!--
    (Enable for distributed operation)

    Specifies a CacheManagerPeerProviderFactory which will be used to create a
    CacheManagerPeerProvider, which discovers other CacheManagers in the cluster.

    The attributes of cacheManagerPeerProviderFactory are:
    * class - a fully qualified factory class name
    * properties - comma separated properties having meaning only to the factory.

    Ehcache comes with a built-in RMI-based distribution system with two means of discovery of
    CacheManager peers participating in the cluster:
    * automatic, using a multicast group. This one automatically discovers peers and detects
      changes such as peers entering and leaving the group
    * manual, using manual rmiURL configuration. A hardcoded list of peers is provided at
      configuration time.

    Configuring Automatic Discovery:
    Automatic discovery is configured as per the following example:
    <cacheManagerPeerProviderFactory
                        class="net.sf.ehcache.distribution.RMICacheManagerPeerProviderFactory"
                        properties="peerDiscovery=automatic, multicastGroupAddress=230.0.0.1,
                                    multicastGroupPort=4446, timeToLive=32"/>

    Valid properties are:
    * peerDiscovery (mandatory) - specify "automatic"
    * multicastGroupAddress (mandatory) - specify a valid multicast group address
    * multicastGroupPort (mandatory) - specify a dedicated port for the multicast heartbeat
      traffic
    * timeToLive - specify a value between 0 and 255 which determines how far the packets will propagate.
      By convention, the restrictions are:
      0   - the same host
      1   - the same subnet
      32  - the same site
      64  - the same region
      128 - the same continent
      255 - unrestricted

    Configuring Manual Discovery:
    Manual discovery is configured as per the following example:
    <cacheManagerPeerProviderFactory class=
                          "net.sf.ehcache.distribution.RMICacheManagerPeerProviderFactory"
                          properties="peerDiscovery=manual,
                          rmiUrls=//server1:40000/sampleCache1|//server2:40000/sampleCache1
                          | //server1:40000/sampleCache2|//server2:40000/sampleCache2"/>

    Valid properties are:
    * peerDiscovery (mandatory) - specify "manual"
    * rmiUrls (mandatory) - specify a pipe separated list of rmiUrls, in the form
                            //hostname:port

    The hostname is the hostname of the remote CacheManager peer. The port is the listening
    port of the RMICacheManagerPeerListener of the remote CacheManager peer.

    An alternate CacheManagerPeerProviderFactory can be used for JNDI discovery of other
    CacheManagers in the cluster. Only manual discovery is supported.

    For cacheManagerPeerProviderFactory specify class
    net.sf.ehcache.distribution.JNDIManualRMICacheManagerPeerProviderFactoryerFactory.

    Correspondingly for cacheManagerPeerListenerFactory specify class
    net.sf.ehcache.distribution.JNDIRMICacheManagerPeerListenerFactoryory.

    Configuring JNDI Manual Discovery:
    Manual JNDI discovery is configured as per the following example:
    <cacheManagerPeerProviderFactory class=
        "net.sf.ehcache.distribution.JNDIManualRMICacheManagerPeerProviderFactoryerFactory"
        properties="peerDiscovery=manual, stashContexts=true, stashRemoteCachePeers=true,
              jndiUrls=t3//server1:40000/sampleCache1|t3//server2:40000/sampleCache1
              |t3//server1:40000/sampleCache2|t3//server2:40000/sampleCache2"/>

    Valid properties are:
    * peerDiscovery (mandatory) - specify "manual"
    * stashContexts (optional) - specify "true" or "false".  Defaults to true.
      java.naming.Context objects are stashed for performance.
    * stashRemoteCachePeers (optional) - specify "true" or "false".  Defaults to true.
      CachePeer objects are stashed for performance.
    * jndiUrls (mandatory) - specify a pipe separated list of jndiUrls,
      in the form protocol//hostname:port
    -->
<!--    <cacheManagerPeerProviderFactory

            properties="peerDiscovery=automatic,
                        multicastGroupAddress=230.0.0.1,
                        multicastGroupPort=4446, timeToLive=1"/>

-->
    <!--
    (Enable for distributed operation)

    Specifies a CacheManagerPeerListenerFactory which will be used to create a
    CacheManagerPeerListener, which
    listens for messages from cache replicators participating in the cluster.

    The attributes of cacheManagerPeerListenerFactory are:
    class - a fully qualified factory class name
    properties - comma separated properties having meaning only to the factory.

    Ehcache comes with a built-in RMI-based distribution system. The listener component is
    RMICacheManagerPeerListener which is configured using
    RMICacheManagerPeerListenerFactory. It is configured as per the following example:

    <cacheManagerPeerListenerFactory
        class="net.sf.ehcache.distribution.RMICacheManagerPeerListenerFactory"
        properties="hostName=fully_qualified_hostname_or_ip,
                    port=40001,
                    socketTimeoutMillis=120000"/>

    All properties are optional. They are:
    * hostName - the hostName of the host the listener is running on. Specify
      where the host is multihomed and you want to control the interface over which cluster
      messages are received. Defaults to the host name of the default interface if not
      specified.
    * port - the port the listener listens on. This defaults to a free port if not specified.
    * socketTimeoutMillis - the number of ms client sockets will stay open when sending
      messages to the listener. This should be long enough for the slowest message.
      If not specified it defaults 120000ms.


    An alternate CacheManagerPeerListenerFactory can be also be used for JNDI binding of
    listeners for messages from cache replicators participating in the cluster. For
    cacheManagerPeerListenerFactory specify
    class net.sf.ehcache.distribution.JNDIRMICacheManagerPeerListenerFactory.
    Correspondingly for cacheManagerPeerProviderFactory specify class
    net.sf.ehcache.distribution.JNDIManualRMICacheManagerPeerProviderFactoryerFactory.
    Properties for JNDIRMICacheManagerPeerListenerFactory are the same as
    RMICacheManagerPeerListenerFactory.

    -->
<!--    <cacheManagerPeerListenerFactory
            class="net.sf.ehcache.distribution.RMICacheManagerPeerListenerFactory"/>
-->

    <!-- Cache configuration.

    The following attributes are required.

    name:
    Sets the name of the cache. This is used to identify the cache. It must be unique.

    maxElementsInMemory:
    Sets the maximum number of objects that will be created in memory

	maxElementsOnDisk:
    Sets the maximum number of objects that will be maintained in the DiskStore
	The default value is zero, meaning unlimited.

    eternal:
    Sets whether elements are eternal. If eternal,  timeouts are ignored and the
    element is never expired.

    overflowToDisk:
    Sets whether elements can overflow to disk when the memory store
    has reached the maxInMemory limit.

    The following attributes are optional.

    timeToIdleSeconds:
    Sets the time to idle for an element before it expires.
    i.e. The maximum amount of time between accesses before an element expires
    Is only used if the element is not eternal.
    Optional attribute. A value of 0 means that an Element can idle for infinity.
    The default value is 0.

    timeToLiveSeconds:
    Sets the time to live for an element before it expires.
    i.e. The maximum time between creation time and when an element expires.
    Is only used if the element is not eternal.
    Optional attribute. A value of 0 means that and Element can live for infinity.
    The default value is 0.

    diskPersistent:
    Whether the disk store persists between restarts of the Virtual Machine.
    The default value is false.

    diskExpiryThreadIntervalSeconds:
    The number of seconds between runs of the disk expiry thread. The default value
    is 120 seconds.

    memoryStoreEvictionPolicy:
    Policy would be enforced upon reaching the maxElementsInMemory limit. Default
    policy is Least Recently Used (specified as LRU). Other policies available -
    First In First Out (specified as FIFO) and Less Frequently Used
    (specified as LFU)

    Cache elements can also contain sub elements which take the same format of a factory class
    and properties. Defined sub-elements are:

    * cacheEventListenerFactory - Enables registration of listeners for cache events, such as
      put, remove, update, and expire.

    * bootstrapCacheLoaderFactory - Specifies a BootstrapCacheLoader, which is called by a
      cache on initialisation to prepopulate itself.

    Each cache that will be distributed needs to set a cache event listener which replicates
    messages to the other CacheManager peers. For the built-in RMI implementation this is done
    by adding a cacheEventListenerFactory element of type RMICacheReplicatorFactory to each
    distributed cache's configuration as per the following example:

    <cacheEventListenerFactory class="net.sf.ehcache.distribution.RMICacheReplicatorFactory"
         properties="replicateAsynchronously=true,
         replicatePuts=true,
         replicateUpdates=true,
         replicateUpdatesViaCopy=true,
         replicateRemovals=true "/>

    The RMICacheReplicatorFactory recognises the following properties:

    * replicatePuts=true|false - whether new elements placed in a cache are
      replicated to others. Defaults to true.

    * replicateUpdates=true|false - whether new elements which override an
      element already existing with the same key are replicated. Defaults to true.

    * replicateRemovals=true - whether element removals are replicated. Defaults to true.

    * replicateAsynchronously=true | false - whether replications are
      asynchronous (true) or synchronous (false). Defaults to true.

    * replicateUpdatesViaCopy=true | false - whether the new elements are
      copied to other caches (true), or whether a remove message is sent. Defaults to true.

    * asynchronousReplicationIntervalMillis=<number of milliseconds> - The asynchronous
      replicator runs at a set interval of milliseconds. The default is 1000. The minimum
      is 10. This property is only applicable if replicateAsynchronously=true

    The RMIBootstrapCacheLoader bootstraps caches in clusters where RMICacheReplicators are
    used. It is configured as per the following example:

    <bootstrapCacheLoaderFactory
        class="net.sf.ehcache.distribution.RMIBootstrapCacheLoaderFactory"
        properties="bootstrapAsynchronously=true, maximumChunkSizeBytes=5000000"/>

    The RMIBootstrapCacheLoaderFactory recognises the following optional properties:

    * bootstrapAsynchronously=true|false - whether the bootstrap happens in the background
      after the cache has started. If false, bootstrapping must complete before the cache is
      made available. The default value is true.

    * maximumChunkSizeBytes=<integer> - Caches can potentially be very large, larger than the
      memory limits of the VM. This property allows the bootstraper to fetched elements in
      chunks. The default chunk size is 5000000 (5MB).

    -->

 <!--
    Mandatory Default Cache configuration. These settings will be applied to caches
    created programmtically using CacheManager.add(String cacheName)
    -->    
    <defaultCache
            maxElementsInMemory="100000"
            eternal="false"
            timeToIdleSeconds="3600"
            timeToLiveSeconds="3600"
            overflowToDisk="true"
            maxElementsOnDisk="500000"
            diskPersistent="true"
            diskExpiryThreadIntervalSeconds="120"
            memoryStoreEvictionPolicy="LRU"
            />
```

```text
package i2.application.sireines.agents

create Task TK_RECHERCHE_AGENTS_BY_CRITERE {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
							AGT_ID,
							GEN_CD,
							NOM,
							PRENOM,
							MATRICULE,
							DATE_NAISSANCE,
							ANNEE_QUALIF,
							CASE WHEN MAX(COM_RANK) = 1 THEN MAX(COM_ID) ELSE NULL END AS COM_ID,
							CASE WHEN MAX(COM_RANK) > 1 THEN 'Multiple' ELSE NULL END AS COM_LB,	
							CASE WHEN MAX(STR_RANK) = 1 THEN MAX(STR_ID) ELSE NULL END AS STR_ID,
							CASE WHEN MAX(COG_RANK) = 1 THEN MAX(COG_ID) ELSE NULL END AS COG_ID,
							CASE WHEN MAX(SRV_RANK) = 1 THEN MAX(SERVICE) ELSE NULL END AS SERVICE,
							SI_ACTIF
						FROM
								 (SELECT 
								 	   AGT.AGT_ID,
									   AGT.GEN_CD,
									   AGT.NOM,
									   AGT.PRENOM,
									   AGT.MATRICULE,
									   AGT.DATE_NAISSANCE,
									   DOS.DOS_ID,
									   DOS.ANNEE_QUALIF AS ANNEE_QUALIF,
									   dense_rank() over (partition by agt.agt_id order by dos.com_id) as COM_RANK,
									   DOS.COM_ID,
									   dense_rank() over (partition by agt.agt_id order by dos.str_id) as STR_RANK,
									   DOS.STR_ID,
									   dense_rank() over (partition by agt.agt_id order by dos.cog_id) as COG_RANK,
									   DOS.COG_ID,
									   dense_rank() over (partition by agt.agt_id order by dos.service) as SRV_RANK,
									   DOS.SERVICE,
									   AGT.SI_ACTIF
								FROM AGENT AGT
								LEFT JOIN DOSSIER DOS ON DOS.AGT_ID = AGT.AGT_ID
								LEFT JOIN DOSSIER DOS2 ON DOS2.AGT_ID = AGT.AGT_ID
								WHERE
									(DOS.ANNEE_QUALIF is null 
									or DOS.ANNEE_QUALIF = (SELECT CASE 
												WHEN MAX(COALESCE(DOS2.ANNEE_QUALIF, 94663287541)) = 94663287541 
												THEN NULL 
												ELSE MAX(DOS2.ANNEE_QUALIF) 
												END FROM DOSSIER DOS2 
											WHERE DOS2.AGT_ID = AGT.AGT_ID 
											GROUP BY DOS2.AGT_ID))
								<%if(agentCritere.getSiActif()!=null) {%>
	                                  and AGT.SI_ACTIF = #AGENT_CRITERE.SI_ACTIF#
	                           <%}%>
								
	                           <%if(agentCritere.getGenCd()!=null) {%>
	                                  and AGT.GEN_CD = #AGENT_CRITERE.GEN_CD#
	                           <%}%>
	                           <%if(agentCritere.getNom()!=null) {%>
	                           		  and (upper(AGT.NOM) like upper(translate(#AGENT_CRITERE.NOM#, '*?', '%%_')) || '%%')
	                           <%}%>
	                           
	                           <%if(agentCritere.getPrenom()!=null) {%>
	                           		  and (upper(AGT.PRENOM) like upper(translate(#AGENT_CRITERE.PRENOM#, '*?', '%%_')) || '%%')
	                           <%}%>
	                           <%if(agentCritere.getMatricule()!=null) {%>
	                           		  and (upper(AGT.MATRICULE) like upper(translate(#AGENT_CRITERE.MATRICULE#, '*?', '%%_')) || '%%')
	                           <%}%>
	                           <%if(agentCritere.getAgtId()!=null) {%>
	                           		  and AGT.AGT_ID = #AGENT_CRITERE.AGT_ID#
	                           <%}%>
	                           <%if(agentCritere.getDateNaissanceInf()!=null) {%>
	                           		  and AGT.DATE_NAISSANCE >= #AGENT_CRITERE.DATE_NAISSANCE_INF#
	                           <%}%>
	                           <%if(agentCritere.getDateNaissanceSup()!=null) {%>
	                           		  and AGT.DATE_NAISSANCE <= #AGENT_CRITERE.DATE_NAISSANCE_SUP#
	                           <%}%>
	                           <%if(agentCritere.getStrId()!=null) {%>
	                           		  and DOS2.STR_ID = #AGENT_CRITERE.STR_ID#
	                           <%}%>
	                           
	                           ) AGT_DOS
	
						GROUP BY AGT_ID, GEN_CD, NOM, PRENOM, MATRICULE, DATE_NAISSANCE, ANNEE_QUALIF, SI_ACTIF
						ORDER BY MATRICULE
						<%if(agentCritere.getResultLimit() != null) {%>
	                      	LIMIT #AGENT_CRITERE.RESULT_LIMIT#
	                    <%}%>
       "
 
       	attribute AGENT_CRITERE		{domain : DO_DT_AGENT_CRITERE_DTO, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute AGENTS	{domain : DO_DT_AGENT_RESULT_DTC, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_COUNT_AGENT_BY_MATRICULE {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
							COUNT(1) AS COUNT
						FROM AGENT
						WHERE MATRICULE = #MATRICULE#
						<%if(agtId != null) {%>
							AND AGT_ID <> #AGT_ID#
						<%}%>"
 
       	attribute MATRICULE		{domain : DO_LIBELLE_20, 						notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
       	attribute AGT_ID		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 						notNull:"false", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute COUNT			{domain : DO_NUMERO, 							notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_GET_AGENTS_BY_SEA_ID {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
							AGT.AGT_ID,
							AGT.MATRICULE,
							AGT.NOM,
							AGT.PRENOM,
							AGT.DATE_NAISSANCE,
							DOS.DOS_ID,
							DOS.BAL_ID,
							DOS.COG_ID,
							DOS.STR_ID	
						FROM AGENT AGT
						JOIN DOSSIER DOS ON AGT.AGT_ID = DOS.AGT_ID
						WHERE DOS.SEA_ID = #SEA_ID#
						ORDER BY AGT.MATRICULE"
 
       	attribute SEA_ID	{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 				notNull:"true", 		inOut :"in"}
    	attribute AGENTS	{domain : DO_DT_AGENT_RESULT_DTC, 		notNull:"true", 		inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_GET_AGENT_BY_DOS_ID {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
							AGT.AGT_ID,
							AGT.MATRICULE,
							AGT.NOM,
							AGT.PRENOM,
							AGT.DATE_NAISSANCE,
							AGT.GEN_CD
						FROM AGENT AGT
						JOIN DOSSIER DOS ON AGT.AGT_ID = DOS.AGT_ID
						WHERE DOS.DOS_ID = #DOS_ID#"
 
       	attribute DOS_ID		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 			notNull:"true",		 inOut :"in"}
    	attribute AGENT			{domain : DO_DT_AGENT_DTO, 			notNull:"true", 	 inOut :"out"}
       
}


```

> **Chemin relatif** : `sireines-web/src/main/resources/i2/application/sireines/services/courriers/courriersDao.ksp`

```text
package i2.application.sireines.courriers

create Task TK_GET_DOSSIER_EDITION_BY_DOS_ID {
	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
	request : "  
				SELECT coalesce(agt.nom,'') as NOM_AGENT, 
					coalesce(agt.prenom,'') as PRENOM_AGENT,
					coalesce(agt.gen_cd,'') as GENRE_CODE,
					coalesce(gen.abrev,'') as GENRE_ABREV,
					coalesce(gen.libelle,'') as GENRE_COMPLET,
					coalesce(str.libelle,'') as STRUCTURE,
					coalesce(str.accord,'') as STRUCTURE_ACCORD,
					coalesce(com.libelle,'') as COMITE_DOMAINE,
					coalesce(dos.service,'') as SERVICE,
					coalesce(dos.date_recep_dossier, NULL) as DATE_RECEPTION,
					coalesce(dos.date_comite, NULL) as DATE_SEANCE,
					dos.date_decision as DATE_DECISION,
					coalesce(dos.annee_qualif,'0') as ANNEE_QUALIF,
					coalesce(dos.migt,'-1') as MIGT,
					coalesce(dos.referent_rh,'') as REFERENT_RH,
					coalesce(dos.referent_rh,'') as CHARGE_MISSION_CORPS,
					coalesce(ges.nom,'') as NOM_GESTIONNAIRE, 
					coalesce(ges.prenom,'') as PRENOM_GESTIONNAIRE,
					coalesce(ges.mail,'') as MAIL_GESTIONNAIRE,
					coalesce(ges.tel,'') as TEL_GESTIONNAIRE,
					coalesce(qua.libelle,'') as QUALIFICATION,
					coalesce(concat(qua.accord, lower(qua.libelle)),'') as QUALIFICATION_ACCORD,
					coalesce(qua.libelle_fem,'') as QUALIFICATION_FEM,
					coalesce(concat(qua.accord, lower(qua.libelle_fem)),'') as QUALIFICATION_FEM_ACCORD,
					case when (agt.gen_CD = 'F') THEN coalesce(cog.libelle_f,'') ELSE coalesce(cog.libelle,'') END as CORPS_GRADE,
					coalesce(dos.poste,'') as POSTE,
					regexp_replace(coalesce(fic_avis.contenu,''), E'\\r\\n', E'\\n', 'g') as FICHE_CONC_AVIS,
					regexp_replace(coalesce(fic_ppro.contenu,''), E'\\r\\n', E'\\n', 'g') as FICHE_CONC_PPRO,
					regexp_replace(coalesce(fic_pind.contenu,''), E'\\r\\n', E'\\n', 'g') as FICHE_CONC_PIND,
					regexp_replace(coalesce(fic_ccl.contenu,''),  E'\\r\\n', E'\\n', 'g') as FICHE_CONC_CCL,
					coalesce(the1.libelle,the11.libelle, mcl1.libelle_autre,'') as MOT_CLE_1,
					coalesce(the2.libelle,the22.libelle, mcl2.libelle_autre,'') as MOT_CLE_2,
					coalesce(the3.libelle,the33.libelle, mcl3.libelle_autre,'') as MOT_CLE_3,
					coalesce(the4.libelle,the44.libelle, mcl4.libelle_autre,'') as MOT_CLE_4,
					coalesce(the5.libelle,the55.libelle, mcl5.libelle_autre,'') as MOT_CLE_5,
					coalesce(dos.mot_cle_sup,'') as MOT_CLE_HORS_THESAURUS,
					case when (agt.gen_CD = 'F') THEN true ELSE false END as SI_ACCORD_FEM,
					coalesce(dos.si_comp_rare, false) as SI_COMP_RARE,
					coalesce(dos.si_comp_crit, false) as SI_COMP_CRITIQUE,
					case when (qua.qua_cd = 'NOQUA' OR qua.qua_cd is null) THEN true ELSE false END as SI_NQ,
					case when (qua.qua_cd = 'NOREC') THEN true ELSE false END as SI_NOREC,
					case when (qua.qua_cd = 'SPECI') THEN true ELSE false END as SI_SPE,
					case when (qua.qua_cd = 'EXPER') THEN true ELSE false END as SI_EXP,
					case when (qua.qua_cd = 'EXPIN') THEN true ELSE false END as SI_EXPI,
					case when (qua.qua_cd = 'CHERC') THEN true ELSE false END as SI_CHERC,
					case when (qua.qua_cd = 'CHECO') THEN true ELSE false END as SI_CHECO,
					case when (qua.qua_cd = 'CHESE') THEN true ELSE false END as SI_CHESE
				FROM agent agt
					INNER JOIN dossier dos ON agt.agt_id = dos.agt_id
					LEFT JOIN genre gen ON agt.gen_cd = gen.gen_cd
					LEFT JOIN comite_domaine com ON dos.com_id = com.com_id
					LEFT JOIN gestionnaire ges ON ges.ges_id = dos.ges_id
					LEFT JOIN qualification qua ON qua.qua_id = dos.qua_id
					LEFT JOIN corps_grade cog ON cog.cog_id = dos.cog_id
					LEFT JOIN structure str on str.str_id = dos.str_id
					LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_avis ON fic_avis.fic_id = dos.fic_id_avis
					LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_ppro ON fic_ppro.fic_id = dos.fic_id_cproj
					LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_pind ON fic_pind.fic_id = dos.fic_id_pind
					LEFT JOIN fiche_conclusion fic_ccl ON fic_ccl.fic_id = dos.fic_id_ccl
					LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1 ON mcl1.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_1
					LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2 ON mcl2.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_2
					LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3 ON mcl3.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_3
					LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4 ON mcl4.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_4
					LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5 ON mcl5.mcl_id = dos.mcl_id_5
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the1 ON mcl1.the_id = the1.the_id
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the2 ON mcl2.the_id = the2.the_id
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the3 ON mcl3.the_id = the3.the_id
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the4 ON mcl4.the_id = the4.the_id
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the5 ON mcl5.the_id = the5.the_id	
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the11 ON dos.mcl_id_1 = the11.the_id + 1000000 
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the22 ON dos.mcl_id_2 = the22.the_id + 1000000 
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the33 ON dos.mcl_id_3 = the33.the_id + 1000000 
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the44 ON dos.mcl_id_4 = the44.the_id + 1000000
					LEFT JOIN thesaurus the55 ON dos.mcl_id_5 = the55.the_id + 1000000			
				WHERE dos.dos_id = #DOS_ID#
	"
	
	attribute DOS_ID {domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    attribute DT_MOT_CLE_EDITION {domain : DO_DT_MOT_CLE_EDITION_DTO, notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
}

create Task TK_GET_DOSSIERS_BY_SEA_ID {
	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
	request : "  
				SELECT
					DOS.DOS_ID,
					COALESCE(DOS.DATE_DECISION, CURRENT_DATE) AS DATE_DECISION
				FROM DOSSIER DOS
				WHERE DOS.SEA_ID = #SEA_ID#	
	"
	
    attribute SEA_ID 	{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 				notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    attribute DOSSIERS 	{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_COURRIER_DTC, 	notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
}

```

```text
package i2.application.sireines.dossiers

create Task TK_RECHERCHE_DOSSIERS_BY_CRITERE {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
							DOS.DOS_ID,
							AGT.NOM,
							AGT.PRENOM,
							DOS.QUA_ID,
							DOS.COM_ID,
							DOS.SEA_ID,
							DOS.BAL_ID,
							DOS.COG_ID,
							DOS.STR_ID
						FROM DOSSIER DOS
						LEFT JOIN AGENT AGT ON DOS.AGT_ID = AGT.AGT_ID
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1 ON mcl1.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_1
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2 ON mcl2.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_2
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3 ON mcl3.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_3
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4 ON mcl4.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_4
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5 ON mcl5.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_5
						WHERE 1=1
						<%if(dossierCritere.getComId()!=null) {%>
                       		  and DOS.COM_ID = #DOSSIER_CRITERE.COM_ID#
                        <%}%>
                        <%if(dossierCritere.getDateSeanceInf()!=null) {%>
                       		  and (DOS.DATE_COMITE >= #DOSSIER_CRITERE.DATE_SEANCE_INF#
                       		  <%if(dossierCritere.getIncSeancesNull()) {%>
                       		  		or DOS.SEA_ID IS NULL
                       		  <%}%>)
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getDateSeanceSup()!=null) {%>
                       		  and (DOS.DATE_COMITE <= #DOSSIER_CRITERE.DATE_SEANCE_SUP#
                       		   <%if(dossierCritere.getIncSeancesNull()) {%>
                       		  		or DOS.SEA_ID IS NULL
                       		  <%}%>)
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(!dossierCritere.getIncSeancesNull()) {%>
                       		  and DOS.SEA_ID IS NOT NULL
               		   <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getIncAgentsActifs()) {%>
               		  		  and AGT.SI_ACTIF = True
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getQuaId()!=null) {%>
                       		  and DOS.QUA_ID = #DOSSIER_CRITERE.QUA_ID#
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getMotCleSup()!=null) {%>
                       		  and DOS.MOT_CLE_SUP = #DOSSIER_CRITERE.MOT_CLE_SUP#
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getMclId1()!=null) {%>
                       		  and ( #DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_1# IN (DOS.MCL_ID_1, DOS.MCL_ID_2, DOS.MCL_ID_3, DOS.MCL_ID_4, DOS.MCL_ID_5) 
                       		  or (#DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_1# IN (mcl1.the_id+1000000, mcl2.the_id+1000000, mcl3.the_id+1000000, mcl4.the_id+1000000, mcl5.the_id+1000000)))
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getMclId2()!=null) {%>
                       		    and ( #DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_2# IN (DOS.MCL_ID_1, DOS.MCL_ID_2, DOS.MCL_ID_3, DOS.MCL_ID_4, DOS.MCL_ID_5) 
                       		  or (#DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_2# IN (mcl1.the_id+1000000, mcl2.the_id+1000000, mcl3.the_id+1000000, mcl4.the_id+1000000, mcl5.the_id+1000000)))
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getMclId3()!=null) {%>
                       		   and ( #DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_3# IN (DOS.MCL_ID_1, DOS.MCL_ID_2, DOS.MCL_ID_3, DOS.MCL_ID_4, DOS.MCL_ID_5) 
                       		  or (#DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_3# IN (mcl1.the_id+1000000, mcl2.the_id+1000000, mcl3.the_id+1000000, mcl4.the_id+1000000, mcl5.the_id+1000000)))
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getMclId4()!=null) {%>
                       		    and ( #DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_4# IN (DOS.MCL_ID_1, DOS.MCL_ID_2, DOS.MCL_ID_3, DOS.MCL_ID_4, DOS.MCL_ID_5) 
                       		  or (#DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_4# IN (mcl1.the_id+1000000, mcl2.the_id+1000000, mcl3.the_id+1000000, mcl4.the_id+1000000, mcl5.the_id+1000000)))
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierCritere.getMclId5()!=null) {%>
                       		   and ( #DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_5# IN (DOS.MCL_ID_1, DOS.MCL_ID_2, DOS.MCL_ID_3, DOS.MCL_ID_4, DOS.MCL_ID_5) 
                       		  or (#DOSSIER_CRITERE.MCL_ID_5# IN (mcl1.the_id+1000000, mcl2.the_id+1000000, mcl3.the_id+1000000, mcl4.the_id+1000000, mcl5.the_id+1000000)))
                       <%}%>
                       
					   ORDER BY AGT.NOM
					   <%if(dossierCritere.getResultLimit() != null) {%>
	                      	LIMIT #DOSSIER_CRITERE.RESULT_LIMIT#
	                   <%}%>
       "
 
       	attribute DOSSIER_CRITERE		{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_CRITERE_DTO, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute DOSSIERS				{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_RESULT_DTC, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_RECHERCHE_DOSSIER_BY_GRADE_STRUCTURE {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
							DOS.DOS_ID,
							AGT.NOM,
							AGT.PRENOM,
							DOS.QUA_ID,
							DOS.COM_ID,
							DOS.SEA_ID,
							DOS.BAL_ID,
							DOS.COG_ID,
							DOS.STR_ID
						FROM DOSSIER DOS
						LEFT JOIN AGENT AGT ON DOS.AGT_ID = AGT.AGT_ID
                        LEFT JOIN CORPS_GRADE CG ON DOS.COG_ID = CG.COG_ID
						LEFT JOIN CORPS ON CG.COR_ID = CORPS.COR_ID
						WHERE 1=1
						
						<%if(dossierGradeStruct.getComId()!=null) {%>
                       		  AND DOS.COM_ID = #DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT.COM_ID#
                        <%}%>
                        
                        <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getDateSeanceInf()!=null) {%>
                       		  <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getIncSeancesNull()) {%>
                       		  		AND DOS.SEA_ID IS NULL
                       		  <%} else {%>
                       		  	AND DOS.DATE_COMITE >= #DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT.DATE_SEANCE_INF#
                       		  <%}%>
                       <%}%>
                       
                       <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getDateSeanceSup()!=null) {%>
                       		  <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getIncSeancesNull()) {%>
                       		  		AND DOS.SEA_ID IS NULL
                       		  <%} else {%>
                       		  		AND DOS.DATE_COMITE <= #DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT.DATE_SEANCE_SUP#
                       		  <%}%>
                       <%}%>
                       
                       <% if (dossierGradeStruct.getDateSeanceInf()==null && dossierGradeStruct.getDateSeanceSup()==null) {%>
                       		
                       		<%if(dossierGradeStruct.getIncSeancesNull()){%>
                       			AND DOS.SEA_ID IS NULL
                       		<%}%>
                       <%}%>
                       
                       <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getIncAgentsActifs()) {%>
               		  		  AND AGT.SI_ACTIF
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getQuaId()!=null) {%>
                       		  AND DOS.QUA_ID = #DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT.QUA_ID#
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getCogId()!=null) {%>
                       		  AND CG.COG_ID = #DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT.COG_ID#
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getCorId()!=null) {%>
                       		  AND CG.COR_ID = #DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT.COR_ID#
                       <%}%>
                       <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getStrId()!=null) {%>
                       		  AND DOS.STR_ID = #DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT.STR_ID#
                       <%}%>
                       group by DOS.DOS_ID, AGT.NOM, AGT.PRENOM, DOS.QUA_ID, DOS.COM_ID, DOS.SEA_ID, DOS.BAL_ID, DOS.COG_ID, DOS.STR_ID
					   ORDER BY AGT.NOM
					   <%if(dossierGradeStruct.getResultLimit() != null) {%>
	                      	LIMIT #DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT.RESULT_LIMIT#
	                   <%}%>
       "
 
       	attribute DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCT		{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_GRADE_STRUCTURE_CRITERE_DTO, 	notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute DOSSIERS					{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_RESULT_DTC, 					notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_RECHERCHE_DOSSIERS_BY_MOTS_CLEFS {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
							DOS.DOS_ID,
							DOS.COM_ID,
							COM.LIBELLE as COM_LIBELLE,
							DOS.SEA_ID,
							SEA.DATE_SEANCE,
							DOS.SEA_ID IS NULL as INC_SEANCES_NULL,
							AGT.NOM,
							AGT.PRENOM,
							AGT.DATE_NAISSANCE,
							AGT.SI_ACTIF as INC_AGENTS_ACTIFS,
							DOS.QUA_ID,
							COR.COR_ID,
							DOS.COG_ID,
							DOS.STR_ID,
							QUA.LIBELLE as QUA_LIBELLE,
							COR.LIBELLE as COR_LIBELLE,
							COG.LIBELLE as COG_LIBELLE,
							STR.LIBELLE as STR_LIBELLE,
							DOS.MCL_ID_1,
							DOS.MCL_ID_2,
							DOS.MCL_ID_3,
							DOS.MCL_ID_4,
							DOS.MCL_ID_5,
							DOS.MOT_CLE_SUP,
							CASE WHEN mcl1.mcl_id IS NOT NULL THEN mcl1.libelle_autre ELSE the1.libelle END AS MCL_LIBELLE_1,
							CASE WHEN mcl2.mcl_id IS NOT NULL THEN mcl2.libelle_autre ELSE the2.libelle END AS MCL_LIBELLE_2,
							CASE WHEN mcl3.mcl_id IS NOT NULL THEN mcl3.libelle_autre ELSE the3.libelle END AS MCL_LIBELLE_3,
							CASE WHEN mcl4.mcl_id IS NOT NULL THEN mcl4.libelle_autre ELSE the4.libelle END AS MCL_LIBELLE_4,
							CASE WHEN mcl5.mcl_id IS NOT NULL THEN mcl5.libelle_autre ELSE the5.libelle END AS MCL_LIBELLE_5, 
							CASE WHEN the1.the_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE the1.libelle_total END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN the2.the_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE the2.libelle_total END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN the3.the_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE the3.libelle_total END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN the4.the_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE the4.libelle_total END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN the5.the_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE the5.libelle_total END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN mcl1.mcl_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE mcl1.mcl_id END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN mcl2.mcl_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE mcl2.mcl_id END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN mcl3.mcl_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE mcl3.mcl_id END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN mcl4.mcl_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE mcl4.mcl_id END ||';'||
							CASE WHEN mcl5.mcl_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE mcl5.mcl_id END as LISTE_MCL_ID
						FROM DOSSIER DOS
						LEFT JOIN agent AGT ON DOS.AGT_ID = AGT.AGT_ID
						LEFT JOIN comite_domaine COM ON DOS.COM_ID = COM.COM_ID 
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl1 ON mcl1.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_1
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl2 ON mcl2.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_2
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl3 ON mcl3.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_3
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl4 ON mcl4.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_4
                        LEFT JOIN mot_cle mcl5 ON mcl5.MCL_ID = DOS.MCL_ID_5
                        LEFT JOIN qualification QUA ON DOS.QUA_ID = QUA.QUA_ID
                        LEFT JOIN corps_grade COG ON DOS.COG_ID = COG.COG_ID
                        LEFT JOIN corps COR ON COG.COR_ID = COR.COR_ID
                        LEFT JOIN structure STR ON DOS.STR_ID = STR.STR_ID
                        LEFT JOIN seance SEA ON DOS.SEA_ID = SEA.SEA_ID
                        LEFT JOIN (select t1.the_id, t1.libelle, t1.the_id+1000000 ||';'|| case when t2.libelle is null then 0 else t2.the_id+1000000 end||';'|| case when t3.libelle is null then 0 else t3.the_id+1000000 end as LIBELLE_TOTAL
								   from thesaurus t1
								   left join thesaurus t2 on t1.id_pere = t2.the_id
								   left join thesaurus t3 on t2.id_pere=t3.the_id ) the1 on the1.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_1
						LEFT JOIN (select t1.the_id, t1.libelle, t1.the_id+1000000 ||';'|| case when t2.libelle is null then 0 else t2.the_id+1000000 end||';'|| case when t3.libelle is null then 0 else t3.the_id+1000000 end as LIBELLE_TOTAL
						 		   from thesaurus t1
						 		   left join thesaurus t2 on t1.id_pere = t2.the_id
								   left join thesaurus t3 on t2.id_pere=t3.the_id ) the2 on the2.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_2
						LEFT JOIN (select t1.the_id, t1.libelle, t1.the_id+1000000 ||';'|| case when t2.libelle is null then 0 else t2.the_id+1000000 end||';'|| case when t3.libelle is null then 0 else t3.the_id+1000000 end as LIBELLE_TOTAL
								   from thesaurus t1
								   left join thesaurus t2 on t1.id_pere = t2.the_id
								   left join thesaurus t3 on t2.id_pere=t3.the_id ) the3 on the3.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_3
						LEFT JOIN (select t1.the_id, t1.libelle, t1.the_id+1000000 ||';'|| case when t2.libelle is null then 0 else t2.the_id+1000000 end||';'|| case when t3.libelle is null then 0 else t3.the_id+1000000 end as LIBELLE_TOTAL
								   from thesaurus t1
								   left join thesaurus t2 on t1.id_pere = t2.the_id
								   left join thesaurus t3 on t2.id_pere=t3.the_id ) the4 on the4.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_4
						LEFT JOIN (select t1.the_id, t1.libelle, t1.the_id+1000000 ||';'|| case when t2.libelle is null then 0 else t2.the_id+1000000 end||';'|| case when t3.libelle is null then 0 else t3.the_id+1000000 end as LIBELLE_TOTAL
								   from thesaurus t1
								   left join thesaurus t2 on t1.id_pere = t2.the_id
								   left join thesaurus t3 on t2.id_pere=t3.the_id ) the5 on the5.the_id+1000000 = dos.mcl_id_5
                        WHERE
                        	DOS.DOS_ID in (#DOSSIERS.ROWNUM.ID#)
       "
       
 		attribute DOSSIERS					{domain : DO_DT_DUMMY_DTC, 							notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
       	attribute DOSSIER_MOTS_CLEFS		{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_MOTS_CLEFS_DTC, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_GET_DOSSIERS_BY_AGT_ID {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
                        	DOS.DOS_ID,
							DOS.COM_ID,
							DOS.SEA_ID,
							DOS.STR_ID,
							DOS.COG_ID,
							DOS.QUA_ID,
							DOS.MCL_ID_1,
							DOS.MCL_ID_2,
							DOS.MCL_ID_3,
							DOS.MCL_ID_4,
							DOS.MCL_ID_5,
							DOS.ANNEE_QUALIF,
							DOS.DATE_DECISION,
							DOS.RAP_ID_PRINCIPAL,
							DOS.DATE_RECEP_DOSSIER
						FROM DOSSIER DOS
						LEFT JOIN SEANCE SEA ON DOS.SEA_ID = SEA.SEA_ID
						LEFT JOIN STRUCTURE STR ON DOS.STR_ID = STR.STR_ID
						LEFT JOIN COMITE_DOMAINE COM ON DOS.COM_ID = COM.COM_ID
						WHERE DOS.AGT_ID = #AGT_ID#
						ORDER BY DOS.DATE_DECISION DESC NULLS FIRST, COM.LIBELLE
				"
 
       	attribute AGT_ID		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 				notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute DOSSIERS		{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_DTC,			notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_GET_LAST_DOSSIER_BY_AGT_ID_AND_COM_ID {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
                            DOS.DOS_ID,
							DOS.COM_ID,
							DOS.DATE_DECISION,
							DOS.QUA_ID
                        FROM DOSSIER DOS
                        WHERE 
                            AGT_ID = #AGT_ID# 
                            AND COM_ID IN 
                                (
                                SELECT 
                                    COM_ID 
                                FROM 
                                    COMITE_DOMAINE 
                                WHERE 
                                    COM_CD IN 
                                        (
                                        SELECT 
                                            COM_CD 
                                        FROM 
                                            COMITE_DOMAINE 
                                        WHERE 
                                            COM_ID = #COM_ID#
                                        )
                                )
                            AND DATE_DECISION IS NOT NULL
                        ORDER BY DATE_DECISION DESC
                        LIMIT 1
                "
 
       	attribute AGT_ID		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 				notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
       	attribute COM_ID		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 				notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute DOSSIER		{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_DTO,			notNull:"false", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_GET_FICHES_CONCLUSION_BY_DOS_ID {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
							AVIS.FIC_ID AS FIC_ID_AVIS,
							AVIS.CONTENU AS CONTENU_AVIS,
							PPROJ.FIC_ID AS FIC_ID_PPROJ,
							PPROJ.CONTENU AS CONTENU_PPROJ,
							PIND.FIC_ID AS FIC_ID_PIND,
							PIND.CONTENU AS CONTENU_PIND,
							CCL.FIC_ID AS FIC_ID_CCL,
							CCL.CONTENU AS CONTENU_CCL
						FROM DOSSIER DOS
						JOIN FICHE_CONCLUSION AVIS ON DOS.FIC_ID_AVIS = AVIS.FIC_ID
						JOIN FICHE_CONCLUSION PPROJ ON DOS.FIC_ID_CPROJ = PPROJ.FIC_ID
						JOIN FICHE_CONCLUSION PIND ON DOS.FIC_ID_PIND = PIND.FIC_ID
						JOIN FICHE_CONCLUSION CCL ON DOS.FIC_ID_CCL = CCL.FIC_ID
						WHERE DOS.DOS_ID = #DOS_ID#
			"
 
       	attribute DOS_ID		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 					notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute FICHES_CCL	{domain : DO_DT_DOSSIER_FICHE_CCL_DTO,		notNull:"false", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_GET_DOCUMENTS_BY_DOS_ID {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
						SELECT
							DOC.DOC_ID,
							DOC.DOS_ID,
							DOC.TYPE_FICHIER,
							DOC.TAILLE,
							DOC.NOM_FICHIER
						FROM DOCUMENT DOC
						WHERE DOC.DOS_ID = #DOS_ID#
			"
 
       	attribute DOS_ID		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 					notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute DOCUMENTS		{domain : DO_DT_DOCUMENT_DTC,				notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_GET_REMARQUES_BY_DOS_ID {

    	attribute REMARQUES		{domain : DO_DT_REMARQUES_DTO,				notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}
```

```text
package i2.application.sireines.services.dossiers

create FacetDefinition FCT_MOTS_CLEFS_QUALIFICATION {
```

```text
package i2.application.sireines.extractions

create Task TK_GET_RUBRIQUE_EXT_BY_LIB {
	   className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
	   request : " 
	   				SELECT rubex.RUB_ID, rubex.LIBELLE  
	   				FROM RUBRIQUE_EXTR rubex 
	   				WHERE 
	   				<%if(libelle != null) {%>
	   					LIBELLE = #LIBELLE# 
	   				<%}%>
		   		"
	attribute LIBELLE 					{domain : DO_LIBELLE_80, 				notNull : "true", 	inOut : "in"}
	attribute RUBRIQUE_EXTR 			{domain : DO_DT_RUBRIQUE_EXTR_DTC, 		notNull : "true", 	inOut : "out"}
}

create Task TK_GET_EXTRACTIONS_WITH_GREATER_ORDER {
	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
	request : "
				SELECT *
				FROM EXTRACTION extr
				WHERE 1=1
				<% if(extractionDetail.getRubId() != null) {%>
					and extr.RUB_ID = #EXTRACTION_DETAIL.RUB_ID#
				<%}%>
				<% if(extractionDetail.getOrdre() != null) {%>
					and extr.ORDRE >= #EXTRACTION_DETAIL.ORDRE#
				<%}%>
		"
		
		attribute EXTRACTION_DETAIL			{domain : DO_DT_EXTRACTION_DETAIL_DTO,		notNull : "true", inOut : "in"}

	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"

				SELECT *
				FROM EXTRACTION extr

				<% if(extractionDetail.getRubId() != null) {%>
					and extr.RUB_ID = #EXTRACTION_DETAIL.RUB_ID#

				<% if(extractionDetail.getOrdre() != null) {%>

				<%}%>
		"

}

create Task TK_GET_ALL_EXTRACTIONS {
	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
	request : "
```

```text
package i2.application.sireines.referentiel

create Task TK_LOAD_ALL_MOT_CLE_MDL{
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
	                SELECT min(TMP.MCL_ID) AS MCL_ID,
					       TMP.MCL_LIBELLE,
					       TMP.SI_ACTIF
					FROM
					(
						 SELECT 
							THE.THE_ID + 1000000 AS MCL_ID, 
							THE.LIBELLE AS MCL_LIBELLE,
							THE.SI_ACTIF
						FROM THESAURUS THE
						
					
						UNION
					
						SELECT
							MCL.MCL_ID AS MCL_ID,
							MCL.LIBELLE_AUTRE,
							false
						FROM MOT_CLE MCL
						WHERE MCL.THE_ID is null
						and MCL.LIBELLE_AUTRE is not null
						
							
					) TMP
					GROUP BY TMP.MCL_LIBELLE,TMP.SI_ACTIF
					ORDER BY TMP.MCL_LIBELLE
       "
 
    	attribute MOTS_CLES				{domain : DO_DT_MOT_CLE_MDL_DTC, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}       
}

create Task TK_COUNT_ALL_MOT_CLE_MDL {
	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
	request : "  
				SELECT count(1) as count
				FROM (
					SELECT	max(TMP.MCL_ID),
						TMP.MCL_LIBELLE
					FROM
					(
						 SELECT 
							THE.THE_ID + 1000000 AS MCL_ID, 
							THE.LIBELLE AS MCL_LIBELLE
						FROM THESAURUS THE
						
				
						UNION
				
						SELECT
							MCL.MCL_ID AS MCL_ID,
							MCL.LIBELLE_AUTRE
						FROM MOT_CLE MCL
						WHERE MCL.THE_ID is null
						and MCL.LIBELLE_AUTRE is not null
					) TMP
					GROUP BY TMP.MCL_LIBELLE
				) TMP2
	"
    attribute COUNT {domain : DO_NUMERO, notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
}


create Task TK_LOAD_MOT_CLE_MDL_BY_ID {
	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
	request : "  
				SELECT 
					TMP.MCL_ID, 
					TMP.MCL_LIBELLE
				FROM
				(
					SELECT 
						THE.THE_ID + 1000000 AS MCL_ID, 
						THE.LIBELLE AS MCL_LIBELLE
					FROM THESAURUS THE
				
					WHERE THE.THE_ID + 1000000= #MCL_ID#  
				
					UNION
				
					SELECT 
						MCL.MCL_ID AS MCL_ID, 
						COALESCE(MCL.LIBELLE_AUTRE, THE.LIBELLE) AS MCL_LIBELLE
					FROM MOT_CLE MCL 
					LEFT JOIN THESAURUS THE ON MCL.THE_ID = THE.THE_ID
					WHERE MCL.MCL_ID = #MCL_ID#
					
				) TMP 
				              
	"
    attribute MCL_ID 		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    attribute MOT_CLE  		{domain : DO_DT_MOT_CLE_MDL_DTO, 	notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
}

create Task TK_RECHERCHE_RAPPORTEURS_BY_CRITERE {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                           SELECT  rap.RAP_ID,
                           		   rap.NOM, 
                                   rap.PRENOM, 
                                   rap.MAIL,
                                   com.libelle AS com_libelle,
                                   rap.GEN_CD,
                                   rap.SI_ACTIF
                           FROM RAPPORTEUR rap
                           JOIN RAP_COM rac ON rap.rap_id = rac.rap_id_com
                           JOIN COMITE_DOMAINE com ON com.com_id = rac.com_id_com
                           WHERE rap.SI_ACTIF = #RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE.SI_ACTIF#
						   <%if(rapporteurCritere.getNom()!=null) {%>
                                  and (upper(rap.NOM) like upper(translate(#RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE.NOM#, '*?', '%%_')) || '%%')
                           <%}%>
                           <%if(rapporteurCritere.getPrenom()!=null) {%>
                                  and (upper(rap.PRENOM) like upper(translate(#RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE.PRENOM#, '*?', '%%_')) || '%%')
                           <%}%>
                           <%if(rapporteurCritere.getMail()!=null) {%>
                                  and (upper(rap.MAIL) like upper(translate(#RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE.MAIL#, '*?', '%%_')) || '%%')
                           <%}%>
                           <%if(rapporteurCritere.getComId()!=null) {%>
                                  and com.COM_ID = #RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE.COM_ID#
                           <%}%>
                           <%if(rapporteurCritere.getGenCd()!=null) {%>
                                  and rap.GEN_CD = #RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE.GEN_CD#
                           <%}%>
                           ORDER BY rap.NOM
                           <%if(rapporteurCritere.getResultLimit() != null) {%>
	                      		LIMIT #RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE.RESULT_LIMIT#
	                  	   <%}%>
       "
 
       	attribute RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE	{domain : DO_DT_RAPPORTEUR_CRITERE_DTO, 	notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute RAPPORTEURS			{domain : DO_DT_RAPPORTEUR_IHM_DTC, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_RECHERCHE_MOT_CLE_NIVEAU {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                           SELECT  th.*
                           FROM THESAURUS th
                           WHERE 1=1
                           <%if(thesaurusCritere.getLibelle()!=null) {%>
                           		  and (upper(th.LIBELLE) like upper(translate(#THESAURUS_CRITERE.LIBELLE#, '*?', '%%_')) || '%%')
                           <%}%>
                           <%if(thesaurusCritere.getNiveau()!=null) {%>
                          	  and th.NIVEAU = #THESAURUS_CRITERE.NIVEAU#
                         	  <%if (thesaurusCritere.getNiveau()==2) {%>
                           	  	 <%if(thesaurusCritere.getIdPremier()!=null) {%>
                           			and th.ID_PERE = #THESAURUS_CRITERE.ID_PREMIER#
                          		 <%}%>
                           	  <%}else {%>
                           	   	<%if(thesaurusCritere.getIdSecond()!=null) {%>
                           			and th.ID_PERE = #THESAURUS_CRITERE.ID_SECOND#
                           	    <%}%>
                           	    <%if(thesaurusCritere.getIdPremier()!=null) {%>
                           	    and th.id_pere in (select n2.the_id from  THESAURUS n2 
                           	    								join THESAURUS n1 on n1.the_id=n2.id_pere 
                           	    								where n1.the_id= #THESAURUS_CRITERE.ID_PREMIER#)                      
                          		 <%}%>
                           	  <%}%>
                           <%}%>
                           <%if(thesaurusCritere.getSiActif()!=null) {%>
                           		and th.SI_ACTIF = #THESAURUS_CRITERE.SI_ACTIF#
                           <%}%>
                           
                           ORDER BY th.LIBELLE
                           <%if(thesaurusCritere.getResultLimit() != null) {%>
	                      		LIMIT #THESAURUS_CRITERE.RESULT_LIMIT#
	                  	   <%}%>
       "
 
       	attribute THESAURUS_CRITERE		{domain : DO_DT_THESAURUS_CRITERE_DTO, 		notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute THESAURUS				{domain : DO_DT_THESAURUS_DTC, 		notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_DETAIL_MOT_CLE_NIVEAU {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
      			 <%if(thesaurus.getNiveau()==1) {%>
                           SELECT  th.THE_ID,
                           th.NIVEAU,
                           th.SI_ACTIF,
                           null as ID_PREMIER,
                           null as ID_SECOND,
                           th.LIBELLE
                           FROM THESAURUS th
                           WHERE th.niveau = #THESAURUS.NIVEAU#
                           and th.THE_ID = #THESAURUS.THE_ID#
                           and th.SI_ACTIF = #THESAURUS.SI_ACTIF#
                <%}%>
                <%if(thesaurus.getNiveau()==2) {%>
                  		SELECT  th.THE_ID,
                           th.NIVEAU,
                           th.SI_ACTIF,
                           n1.THE_ID as ID_PREMIER,
                           null as ID_SECOND,
                           th.LIBELLE
                           FROM THESAURUS th
                           join THESAURUS n1 on th.id_pere = n1.the_id
                           WHERE th.niveau = #THESAURUS.NIVEAU#
                           and th.THE_ID = #THESAURUS.THE_ID#
                           and th.SI_ACTIF = #THESAURUS.SI_ACTIF#
                 <%}%>
                 <%if(thesaurus.getNiveau()==3) {%>
                     	SELECT  th.THE_ID,
                           th.NIVEAU,
                           th.SI_ACTIF,
                           n2.THE_ID as ID_PREMIER,
                           n1.THE_ID as ID_SECOND,
                           th.LIBELLE
                           FROM THESAURUS th
                           join THESAURUS n1 on th.id_pere = n1.the_id
                           join THESAURUS n2 on n1.id_pere = n2.the_id
                           WHERE th.niveau = #THESAURUS.NIVEAU#
                           and th.THE_ID = #THESAURUS.THE_ID#
                           and th.SI_ACTIF = #THESAURUS.SI_ACTIF#
                 <%}%>
                 ORDER BY LIBELLE
       "
 
       	attribute THESAURUS				{domain : DO_DT_THESAURUS_DTO, 		notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute THESAURUS_DETAIL		{domain : DO_DT_THESAURUS_DETAIL_DTO, 		notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

}

create Task TK_MISE_NON_ACTIF_FILS {
```

```text
package i2.application.sireines.seances

create Task TK_GET_SEANCES_BY_CRITERE {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
                        	SEA.SEA_ID,
							SEA.COM_ID,
							SEA.DATE_SEANCE,
							COUNT(DOS.DOS_ID) AS COUNT_DOSSIER
						FROM SEANCE SEA
						LEFT JOIN DOSSIER DOS ON DOS.SEA_ID = SEA.SEA_ID
						WHERE 1=1
						<%if (seanceCritere.getComId() != null) { %>
							AND SEA.COM_ID = #SEANCE_CRITERE.COM_ID#
						<% } %>
						<%if (seanceCritere.getDateSeanceInf() != null) { %>
							AND SEA.DATE_SEANCE >= #SEANCE_CRITERE.DATE_SEANCE_INF#
						<% } %>
						<%if (seanceCritere.getDateSeanceSup() != null) { %>
							AND SEA.DATE_SEANCE <= #SEANCE_CRITERE.DATE_SEANCE_SUP#
						<% } %>
						GROUP BY SEA.SEA_ID, SEA.COM_ID, SEA.DATE_SEANCE
						ORDER BY SEA.DATE_SEANCE
						<%if(seanceCritere.getResultLimit() != null) {%>
	                      	LIMIT #SEANCE_CRITERE.RESULT_LIMIT#
	                    <%}%>"
 
       	attribute SEANCE_CRITERE		{domain : DO_DT_SEANCE_CRITERE_DTO, 		notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute SEANCES				{domain : DO_DT_SEANCE_RESULT_DTC,			notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_GET_SEANCES_BY_COM_ID {
       className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineSelect"
       request : " 
                        SELECT
                        	SEA.SEA_ID,
							SEA.DATE_SEANCE
						FROM SEANCE SEA
						WHERE SEA.COM_ID = #COM_ID#
						AND SEA.SI_SEANCE_DEFINITIVE IS FALSE
						AND SEA.DATE_SEANCE IS NOT NULL"
 
       	attribute COM_ID		{domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 			notNull:"true", inOut :"in"}
    	attribute SEANCES		{domain : DO_DT_SEANCE_DTC,			notNull:"true", inOut :"out"}
       
}

create Task TK_UPDATE_SEANCE_COMITE_INTO_DOSSIER{
	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineProc"
	request : "		
				UPDATE DOSSIER 
				SET 
				SEA_ID = #SEA_ID#,
				DATE_COMITE = (SELECT DATE_SEANCE FROM SEANCE WHERE SEA_ID = #SEA_ID#) 
				WHERE DOS_ID = #DOS_ID#"
					
	attribute SEA_ID	 {domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 	notNull:"true", 	inOut :"in"}
	attribute DOS_ID 	 {domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 	notNull:"true", 	inOut :"in"}
}

create Task TK_UPDATE_DATE_SEANCE_COMITE_INTO_DOSSIER{
	className : "io.vertigo.dynamox.task.TaskEngineProc"
	request : "		
				UPDATE DOSSIER 
				SET 
				DATE_COMITE = (SELECT DATE_SEANCE FROM SEANCE WHERE SEA_ID = #SEA_ID#) 
				WHERE SEA_ID = #SEA_ID#"
					
	attribute SEA_ID 	 	 {domain : DO_IDENTIFIER, 	notNull:"true", 	inOut :"in"}
}


```

```xml
<!DOCTYPE log4j:configuration SYSTEM "log4j.dtd">
<log4j:configuration xmlns:log4j="http://jakarta.apache.org/log4j/">

		<param name="File" value="/usr/local/tomcat/logs/LOG_FILE" />
		<param name="Append" value="true" />
		<param name="MaxFileSize" value="50000KB" />
		<param name="MaxBackupIndex" value="5" />
		<layout class="org.apache.log4j.PatternLayout">
			<param name="ConversionPattern"
				value="%d{yyyyMMdd} %d{HH:mm:ss} [%t] %-5p %-11c{1} - %m %x %n" />
		</layout>
	</appender>
	
	<appender name="STDOUT" class="org.apache.log4j.ConsoleAppender">
		<layout class="org.apache.log4j.PatternLayout">
			<param name="ConversionPattern"
				value="%d{yyyyMMdd} %d{HH:mm:ss} [%t] %-5p %-11c{1} - %m %x %n" />
		</layout>
	</appender>

	<logger name="i2.application.sireines">

		<appender-ref ref="STDOUT" />

	<logger name="Task">

		<appender-ref ref="FILE_LOG" />
	</logger>
	
	<logger name="Sql">

		<appender-ref ref="FILE_LOG" />
	</logger>
	
	<logger name="transaction">
```

```text
 *
 */
-->
<#if (actionMessages?? && actionMessages?size > 0 && !parameters.isEmptyList)>
<#assign panelRendered = false/>
<#list actionMessages as message>
	<#if message?if_exists != "" && message?starts_with('WARNING:')>
		<#if !panelRendered>
<div class="warningPanel">
	<ul <#rt/>
			<#if parameters.id?if_exists != "">
			 id="${parameters.id?html}" <#t/>
			</#if>
			<#if parameters.cssClass??>
			 class="${parameters.cssClass?html}" <#t/>
			<#else>
			 class="actionMessage" <#t/>
			</#if>
			<#if parameters.cssStyle??>
			 style="${parameters.cssStyle?html}"<#t/>
			</#if>
	><#lt/>
		<#assign panelRendered = true/>
		</#if>
		<#assign warnMessage = message!?substring('WARNING:'?length)>
		<#assign warnFieldMessage = warnMessage?matches("<label>(.+)</label>(.+)$")>
		<#if warnFieldMessage>
			<#list warnFieldMessage as m> 
		<li><span class="messageLabel">${m?groups[1]?html}: </span><span class="message"><#if parameters.escape>${m?groups[2]?html}<#else>${m?groups[2]!}</#if></span></li>
	        	</#list> 
		<#else>
		<li><span><#if parameters.escape>${warnMessage?html}<#else>${warnMessage!}</#if></span></li>
		</#if>				 
	</#if>
</#list>
<#if panelRendered>
	</ul>
</div>
</#if>
```

```text
<#--
	This template handles: 
		* intializing controlLayout.currentColumnCount if it has not been initialzed,
		* emiting a <tr> tag if the currentColumnCount == 0,
-->
<#if ! controlLayout_currentColumnCount?exists >
	<#-- Set the currentColumnCount to 0 because this is the first row of the table. -->
	${stack.setValue('#controlLayout_currentColumnCount', 0)}
</#if>
<#-- Do we need to write the opening tr tag. -->
<#if controlLayout_tablecolspan?exists >
	<#assign columnCount = controlLayout_currentColumnCount />
<#else>
	<#-- Set the currentColumnCount to 0 because this is the first row of the table. -->
	${stack.setValue('#controlLayout_currentColumnCount', 0)}
	<#assign columnCount = 0 />
</#if>
<#if columnCount == 0>
	<#-- Write out the opening tr tag to start the table row. -->
	<tr>
</#if>

```

```text
<h2 class="title">Gestion des agents</h2>
<p>La section "Agents" vous permet d'enregistrer, suivre et modifier les agents ayant d&eacute;pos&eacute; une demande de qualification.</p>

<h2 class="title">Gestion des dossiers</h2>
<p>La section "Dossiers" vous permet d'enregistrer, suivre et modifier les dossiers de demande de qualification.</p>

<h2 class="title">Gestion des s&eacute;ances de comit&eacute;</h2>
<p>La section "S&eacute;ances de comit&eacute;" vous permet de planifier les s&eacute;ances d'&eacute;valuation des dossiers par les comit&eacute;s de domaine.</p>

<h2 class="title">Extraction des donn&eacute;es</h2>
<p>La section "Extractions" vous permet de g&eacute;n&eacute;rer des &eacute;tats et des statistiques &agrave; partir des donn&eacute;es contenues dans les dossiers.</p>

<h2 class="title">Gestion du r&eacute;f&eacute;rentiel</h2>
<p>La section "R&eacute;f&eacute;rentiels" vous permet d'administrer les listes de r&eacute;f&eacute;rences utilis&eacute;es dans l'application.</p>

<s:include value="/jsp/include/footer.jsp" />
```

```text
<h1>Mentions Légales</h1>

<p>Direction de la Recherche et de l'Innovation, Tour Sequoia, 92055

	techniques (DRI/AST4) tient à jour la base de données dénommée SIREINES
	qui recense toutes les personnes qualifiées par les comités de domaine.
	Celle-ci permet de faire apparaître la mention de la qualification
	obtenue, l'année d'obtention, le nom du comité de domaine et les mots
	clés caractérisant la nature de la spécialisation et de l'expertise.</p>

<h2>Directeur de publication</h2>
<p>Laurent TAPADINHAS, Directeur de la DRI (Direction de la
	Recherche et de l'Innovation)</p>

<h2>Centre hébergeur</h2>
<p>CP2I - Département Opérationnel Infrastructures de Production<br/>
	(DOIP) Rue Pierre Ramond - CS60013 33166 Saint-Médard-en Jalles cedex<br/>
	Tél. : 05 56 70 66 33</p>

<h2>Informatique et libertés</h2>
<p>"SIREINES" a fait l'objet d'une déclaration modificative à la
	CNIL sous la référence 1034232. <br/>Conformément à la loi n°78-17 du 6
	janvier 1978, vous disposez à tout moment d'un droit d'opposition,
	d'accès, de modification, de suppression et de rectification des
	données vous concernant. Ce droit peut être exercé auprès du ministère
	par courrier postal (MEDDE/DGPR/SRT/SDRA/BSERR - 92055 La Défense,
	France) ou en envoyant un mail à l'adresse électronique suivante :
	Ast4.Ast.Dri.Cgdd@developpement-durable.gouv.fr.</p>

<h2>Transmission d'information</h2>
<p>L'administrateur général se réserve le droit de publier (ou non) tout ou
en partie les informations qui lui sont transmises, sans contrainte de
délais de mise en ligne. Les photographies, textes et autres documents
transmis à l'administrateur sont réputés "libre de droit" et ne
sauraient engager de quelque manière que ce soit la responsabilité de la
Direction de la Recherche et de l'Innovation.</p>
```
